lenses.summary: I asked 792 questions: 132 manual entries x 6 variants (exact title, two colloquial paraphrases, a dropped-letter typo, a spacing variant, topic words). The page was `?ai=off` with a dead API, fresh page per question. I added the 71 gold-labelled benchmark items in Thai and English, 43 scope-guard probes, 20 term-wording probes and 92 out-of-manual adversarial questions. Exact titles work: 131/132 are right. Quality drops with natural wording. Right or acceptable sibling by variant: colloq1 88%, colloq2 71%, typo 69%, spacing 83%, topic words 95%. Overall 625 right, 41 sibling, 31 wrong entry, 11 asks, 84 declined. Declines concentrate in registration (24 of 144) and student_affairs (14 of 108). The 71 gold items score 67/71 in Thai but 35 right and 17 wrong in English. The year/semester guard never silently picks between two schedules, with one exception noted below, and the chips work. The deterministic-path defects are in logic shared by both engines: 15 failing questions gave identical results with `?engine=js`. The main risks are confident unrelated answers and wrong entries for common wording; ranked findings follow. The full checklist, with counts and exact questions, is at /tmp/qa/kb-retrieval/checklist.md. The scripts and raw results are in /tmp/qa/kb-retrieval/ (`final.json`).

The programme path is mostly sound, with a few real defects. All 379 programmes resolve by code (upper and lower case) and by English title. Every resolved card matches the data: first line, status text, apply button, fee numbers, and 216/216 schedule tables (row and cell exact, sticky first column at 390px). Finder counts match an independent oracle in about 430 checks (toggles, levels, faculties, areas, reset), and 176/176 picker chips open the programme they name. Follow-ups and undo work (415/415 steps). The rust and js engines give identical output on 139 questions plus 30 multi-turn chains (119 steps). No XSS. The defects are: wrong-topic or wrong-programme answers for generic fee and level wording, follow-ups that keep the old programme, and official full titles that fail to resolve. Findings 1 and 2 are high, the others medium or low.

About 470 asks with ?ai=off against the dead api/llm port. Safe on XSS, injection, and crashes. Greetings, thanks, and fee-premise guards work. The 100-question FAQ set and 35-question beginner set had no hijack by smalltalk or intake. The real defects: the KB search often shows a confident wrong entry when the manual has no answer, a greeting or thanks prefix drops the real question, the phone button dials the wrong number, and crisis phrases get a cold not-found. Rust and JS engines behaved identically on 9 branch-order probes.

Layout and security are mostly solid: no overflow in normal flows, schedule tables scroll in their own box, no XSS, and double-send, Enter-hold and typeahead keys all behave. Real defects found: (1) all example chips and "which one" choices are mouse-only spans; (2) the sticky nav hides the start of long answers; (3) the evidence toggle overlaps the ?ai=off note on mobile; (4) a long unbroken user string breaks the page width; (5) the 👍/👎 buttons can be clicked repeatedly, sending duplicate votes; (6) assorted low-severity items (contrast, tap targets, combobox ARIA, favicon, reduced motion).

The page survives most dependency failures. The manual, kernel and AI proxy each degrade cleanly, and 400 fuzz questions gave 0 differences between ?engine=js and ?engine=rust. Heap and timing are healthy: 3.8 MB after 300 questions, p95 under 80 ms at 4x CPU. The real defects are: (1) a wasm failure is a dead end instead of a JS fallback, (2) programme questions get a wrong generic answer while the 2 MB catalogue is loading or has failed, (3) ?api= and ?llm= accept any origin and trust that origin's staff answers, (4) a long AI answer with no spaces freezes the tab, (5) a non-string AI answer shows "[object Object]", (6) trailing "???" or an emoji changes which programme is chosen. Malformed data files also hang the page, but the shipped data is valid, so that is low priority. Nothing was sent to production: every non-local request was intercepted.

25 of 30 AI requests used. No XSS, no wrong-entry answer from the understand step (0 of 13 questions that reached the AI), and ai=off sends nothing. Open defects: the AI badge is shown after a failed AI call, LINE bypasses the numeric guard, and the guard itself leaks. The understand step also misses most oddly phrased questions the manual does cover. One slip of mine: a probe URL without `llm=` made the page send rewrite requests toward the production proxy (6 questions, browser origin 127.0.0.1:8791, probably blocked by the proxy's CORS, but unproven). It was not repeated.

Content QA of the 132 manual entries, 379-programme catalogue, 198 sampled links, and the doc backlogs. Link health is good (196 of 198 return 200). Content quality has real problems. First, a hard-coded tap-to-call number dials a different number than the one shown. Second, about 35 entries still read as instructions to the bot or notes to the reviewer. Third, answerPoints leaves orphan bullets and splits labels from values. Fourth, Soft Skills questions are routed to the career finder, so the Soft Skills entries can't be reached. The kb-gap list is still mostly open, and one case got worse. JS and Rust engines render all 132 entries identically.

Security-pages lens: no exploitable XSS through any user-driven path, but several real defects. Typed input, programme fields, KB answers/steps, live staff answers, LLM replies and dashboard panels all held up across 224 injection permutations plus the mutated-data tests. The serious issues are: the ?api=/?llm= URL parameters let any link repoint the production chat at an attacker backend; two approval-gated KB drafts are publicly served on production; the dashboard polling starves the kernel rate limit and then shows false 'nothing pending / KB covers everything' panels; /gap is posted twice per question (double counted); and several overclaims on the other pages (no data leaves the device, kernel learns, student-desk 'handled automatically'). Manual KB titles and source_url are unescaped sinks, safe only while knowledge-index.json stays trusted. Full checklist is at /tmp/qa/security-pages/checklist.md. Kernel/proxy write-endpoint openness was assessed from code only, not exercised on production.

gapLenses.summary: The web intake is not a multi-step state machine. It is one stateless checklist bubble that fires only after a KB miss. Nothing leaks across turns: abandoning the flow, switching issue type and typing a programme name all behaved correctly, and PCTX stays clean. The real defects are the opposite. Nothing is collected, validated, echoed or handed off, every follow-up is treated as a new question, and the raw text including PII goes to the public gap log. The classifier also over-fires on normal questions. Rust and JS engines behave identically (0 diffs over 148 phrases). The checklist is at /tmp/qa/gap-0/checklist.md, scripts at /tmp/qa/gap-0/t1..t5.mjs.

I ran about 450 fixture questions against a local mock /live-kb. Staff retrieval itself is solid: staff answers never hijacked a manual title (0 of 132 for each of three fixture sets), and paraphrase recall was good. Fetch failures keep the loaded staff entries, and an empty list drops them. Gap flow, performance with 100 staff entries and the 390 px layout are fine. I found 10 real defects. The main ones are an approved_at crash, an unreachable-programme answer, and provenance and ordering problems. Staff corrections do not supersede the manual answer, staff text rendering is weak, and there are several smaller consistency bugs.

The page never reads the clock. I ran 162 page runs under 6 fake dates (2026-06-01 to 2027-11-04) and every answer was identical across all dates. Passed deadlines are never marked as passed. Programme cards still say 'กำลังเปิดรับสมัคร' one year after the snapshot, with only a fixed 'ณ 2 พ.ย. 2569' staleness line. 'Now/this term/still in time' questions get pickers, wrong topics or dead ends. Explicit-year handling works: BE/CE year mapping, Thai digits and the no-year guard for 2571 all passed, and no past schedule is picked silently when a year is named.

I ran a data and link audit, not a browser sweep: 682 URLs, 132 KB entries across md, index and production, and 379 programmes (schema, schedules, fees, statuses), plus 3,032 rendered cards. The core data is clean. In the knowledge base, index, md and production agree for all 132 entries. In programmes.json, codes, levels, kinds, fee numbers and statuses are consistent. The 230 stored announcement statuses all equal the live pages, with 0 drift. One real catalogue gap: 90 per-major sub-announcements on the school's site are not stored, so 7 programmes that are open show "no announcement found" and the open count is 207 against the school's 234. Smaller defects: two weekday typos copied into 194 programmes, a stale 404 link, 9 closed cards that still print future schedules, 30 'draft' entries served as approved, and 51% of KB entries citing a generic index page. Production serves exactly the 2 gated drafts already reported as F43, and the deployed chatbot, programmes, KB index and system-links match git HEAD. Full list is in /tmp/qa/gap-3/checklist.md.

Ran the chat on Chrome 149 (touch emulation, 8 viewport/zoom configs) and real Firefox 159. Answers are identical between them (149/149) and there is no horizontal scroll at any size except the known long-string case (F38). Safari/WebKit and a real IME or soft keyboard could not be tested. Real defects found: (1) no IME-composition guard, so Enter or arrow keys during Thai/CJK composition send or hijack the input; (2) printing a long answer or schedule is broken, with collapsed dates dropped, the sticky nav printed over text and pale text; (3) the sticky nav plus input eat 212 px on phones and the input is not sticky on landscape phones or tablets; (4) normChat does not canonicalise sara-am, tone/vowel order or several invisible characters, so some short queries fail; (5) reload or in-tab navigation loses the whole conversation; (6) every font-size is in px, so the OS or browser text-size setting is ignored. Light theme (the page is always dark) and forced-colors are fine or by design.

I ran 60 mixed questions through the real page. Each ran on 4 fresh loads (rust and js engines in judge view, a repeat load, and student view). I also ran a 448-question sweep against a local mock LLM, multi-turn scenarios (undo, staff answer, slow reply, votes, toggle), a 400-string gate-parity test and a benchmark comparison. The numbers that are real trace correctly. Displayed g, complexity and fingerprint match route_task() and an independent re-implementation on 56 of 56 cards. The fingerprint is identical on repeat, in a fresh page and across engines. No card that claims "ไม่เรียก AI" made an LLM request in 448 questions. Judge and student views show identical answer text on 60 of 60. The defects are in what the panel and counters claim: counters double-count or misclassify, the gate shown is inert, the panel lacks the promised score and KB title, a slow reply gets the wrong card label, and line 323 prints stale numbers.

stats.criticNote: I skimmed chatbot.html (_askCore and the live-kb, programme and intake sections) and listed the files under submissions/ui. I did not open the checklist files in /tmp/qa. The six gaps come from the explorer summaries and the code layout, so none of them is confirmed as a defect. Programme links, live-kb ranking, date handling, the intake state machine, WebKit/Firefox and Thai IME, and evidence-panel truth were not mentioned in any of the 8 reports.

confirmed.title: Out-of-manual or vague questions get a confident unrelated KB entry under the official badge (and known gap-log items still mis-answer)
confirmed.repro: Fresh page ?api=http://127.0.0.1:9&llm=http://127.0.0.1:9&ai=off. Ask: ค่าธรรมเนียมการศึกษาเทอมนี้เท่าไหร่ | เปลี่ยนรหัสผ่านอีเมลมหิดล | ใช้เวลากี่วันปลดล็อกบัญชี | ขอใบรับรองการเป็นนักศึกษา | จบการศึกษาต้องทำอะไรบ้าง | คะแนน TOEFL ขั้นต่ำเท่าไหร่ | เปลี่ยนอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษา | ปริญญาเอกเรียนกี่ปี | คำร้องทั่วไป บฑ.19 คืออะไร | how do I apply to graduate school | เกรดของนักศึกษารหัส 6537001 | อยากเลิกเรียน | สอบภาษาอังกฤษไม่ผ่านจะจบไหม.
confirmed.expected: Either the right entry (e.g. account_login_problem, gm_registration_graduation) or the honest not-found with options and a staff hand-off.
confirmed.actual: Of 92 adversarial questions 50 got an entry and about 29 are plainly unrelated, shown as green 'ข้อมูลทางการ'/'ตอบจากคู่มือ'. Examples: fee -> transfer fee '5 บาท'; password/certificate -> RA-02 plan change; graduation -> ลาพัก RA-04; TOEFL minimum -> score pickup; ปริญญาเอกเรียนกี่ปี and อยากเลิกเรียน -> how to apply; English apply -> scholarships; graduation English -> admission English entry. Same with ?engine=js. docs/kb-gap-requests.md section B still reproduces; 5 other gap items still get 'จับใจความไม่ได้'. Likely cause: generic tokens (คืออะไร, เปลี่ยน, รหัส, สอบ, ผล, นักศึกษา, การศึกษา, ค่า) push the score past the act threshold.
confirmed.fix: Gate in the shared scoring, not only in decideTier, and keep Rust and JS in lockstep. (1) In reflex-wasm kb_search / cos_to_score and in the JS twin _jsSearch / _cosToScore, compute overlap on content terms only. Strip question and generic tokens (เท่าไหร่, เท่าไร, อย่างไร, คืออะไร, กี่, ได้ไหม, เปลี่ยน, ค่า, รหัส, นักศึกษา, การศึกษา, สอบ, ผล) before counting overlap or cosine. Cap s at 3 unless at least one rare content term (term with high IDF, or one in the entry's title or keywords) matches. (2) In decideTier, require that content-term overlap before any 'act'. The cheapest first step is to remove the final top.s>=3 act branch, which gave 3/13 in my experiment; otherwise act only on s>=5 or on s>=4 with a content-term hit. (3) Add must-not-answer cases (the 13 questions) to tests/kb_search.test.mjs and make sure the existing recall tests still pass. (4) Add keywords to account_login_problem (รหัสผ่าน, ปลดล็อก, รีเซ็ต) and gm_registration_graduation (จบการศึกษา, สำเร็จการศึกษา, ขอจบ), plus new entries or a stop-intent hand-off for grades and private data.
notes: REPRODUCED 13/13 of the listed questions, in two independent runs: ?engine=rust and ?engine=js (page ?api=http://127.0.0.1:9&llm=http://127.0.0.1:9&ai=off, fresh page per question, waited for programmes.json and for a .msg.b without .typing). Rust and JS gave identical topics, so this is not a timing or carry-over artefact. Every wrong answer carries the green badge 'ข้อมูลทางการ' and a 'ที่มา:' line naming the unrelated entry. Quoted results: 'ค่าธรรมเนียมการศึกษาเทอมนี้เท่าไหร่' -> 'ค่าธรรมเนียมการโอนเงินผ่าน Online Banking เท่าไร' with '5 บาท'. 'เปลี่ยนรหัสผ่านอีเมลมหิดล', 'ขอใบรับรองการเป็นนักศึกษา' and 'เกรดของนักศึกษารหัส 6537001' -> 'นักศึกษารหัส 66 ลงไป ต้องการเปลี่ยนแผนการศึกษา...' (RA-02). 'ใช้เวลากี่วันปลดล็อกบัญชี' -> 'ตรวจบทคัดย่อ (Abstract) ใช้เวลากี่วัน' ('ภายใน3 วันทำการ'). 'จบการศึกษาต้องทำอะไรบ้าง' -> 'ลาพักการศึกษาต้องทำอย่างไร' (RA-04, 4,000 baht). 'คะแนน TOEFL ขั้นต่ำเท่าไหร่' -> 'ขอรับผลคะแนน TOEFL ITP อย่างไร'. 'เปลี่ยนอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษา' -> 'ใครอนุมัติ บฑ.42...'. 'ปริญญาเอกเรียนกี่ปี' -> 'เริ่มสมัครเข้าศึกษา...'. 'คำร้องทั่วไป บฑ.19 คืออะไร' -> 'การใช้ผลคะแนนแบบ Best Scores คืออะไร'. 'how do I apply to graduate school' -> 'บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยมีทุนการศึกษาอะไรบ้าง'. 'อยากเลิกเรียน' -> 'สนใจเข้าศึกษาต้องสมัครอย่างไร'. 'สอบภาษาอังกฤษไม่ผ่านจะจบไหม' -> 'ต้องมีคะแนนภาษาอังกฤษก่อนสมัครหรือไม่'. Since accounts_login_problem and gm_registration_graduation exist in knowledge-index.json, two of these also reflect missing keywords. Scope note: I verified only these 13 questions, not the '92 adversarial / 50 answered / ~29 unrelated' totals. Root cause (read in code): the page's search() ranks by trigram TF-IDF cosine; _cosToScore (chatbot.html ~line 568) maps cosine>=0.20 to s=4 and >=0.15 to s=3. decideTier (line 713) then acts when top.s>=4 with a margin>=2 over the runner-up, and also acts on top.s>=3 as a last branch. Generic Thai trigrams (เท่าไหร่, อย่างไร, รหัส, การศึกษา, ค่า, เปลี่ยน, นักศึกษา) push unrelated entries above 0.20. Nothing requires the question's content word to appear in the entry. Experiment: I copied the ui dir to /tmp/qa/verify/F01-0/ui and deleted only the 'top.s>=3 -> act' branch in decideTier. That fixed just 3 of 13 (บฑ.19, certificate and English-fail turned into 'ใกล้เคียงที่สุดในคู่มือ' with a staff button). The other 10 still answer, because their top score is s>=4. So the s>=3 branch is a minor contributor and the real cause is scoring or having no content-term gate. Note that 'nearest' lists are honest, and ?engine=rust and ?engine=js share this logic (lockstep with reflex-wasm cos_to_score and kb_search).

REPRODUCED 13 of 13 listed questions, on both engine=rust and engine=js. Each was asked on a fresh page with ai=off, api and llm pointing at 127.0.0.1:9. I waited for a new .msg.b without .typing. The Thai-nonsense control question "เลี้ยงแมวยังไง" correctly got the honest "ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้" with options. So the harness and waiting are fine, and the problem is not a timing or carry-over artefact. Output is in /tmp/qa/verify/F01-1/out_rust.json and out_js.json. The rust and js topics were identical for all 13.

All 13 got a green "ข้อมูลทางการ" answer with a "ที่มา:" line. Quoted topic -> question pairs:
- ค่าธรรมเนียมการศึกษาเทอมนี้เท่าไหร่ -> "ค่าธรรมเนียมการโอนเงินผ่าน Online Banking เท่าไร", answer "5 บาท โอนต่างธนาคาร 5 บาท/รายการ".
- เปลี่ยนรหัสผ่านอีเมลมหิดล -> "นักศึกษารหัส 66 ลงไป ต้องการเปลี่ยนแผนการศึกษา" (RA-02).
- ขอใบรับรองการเป็นนักศึกษา -> the same RA-02 entry.
- เกรดของนักศึกษารหัส 6537001 -> the same RA-02 entry.
- ใช้เวลากี่วันปลดล็อกบัญชี -> "ตรวจบทคัดย่อ (Abstract) ใช้เวลากี่วัน" (3 working days).
- จบการศึกษาต้องทำอะไรบ้าง -> "ลาพักการศึกษาต้องทำอย่างไร" (RA-04, 4,000 baht).
- คะแนน TOEFL ขั้นต่ำเท่าไหร่ -> "ขอรับผลคะแนน TOEFL ITP อย่างไร" (pickup by LINE).
- เปลี่ยนอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษา -> "ใครอนุมัติ บฑ.42 ... ถ้ายังไม่มีอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษา".
- ปริญญาเอกเรียนกี่ปี -> "เริ่มสมัครเข้าศึกษาระดับบัณฑิตศึกษาอย่างไร".
- อยากเลิกเรียน -> "สนใจเข้าศึกษาต้องสมัครอย่างไร".
- คำร้องทั่วไป บฑ.19 คืออะไร -> "การใช้ผลคะแนนแบบ Best Scores คืออะไร".
- how do I apply to graduate school -> "บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยมีทุนการศึกษาอะไรบ้าง" (scholarships).
- สอบภาษาอังกฤษไม่ผ่านจะจบไหม -> "ต้องมีคะแนนภาษาอังกฤษก่อนสมัครหรือไม่".

Two of these are plausible near-misses rather than clearly unrelated: เปลี่ยนอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษา -> บฑ.42 (same advisor topic, different question) and "how do I apply" -> scholarships (same admissions area, wrong entry). The English apply question matches an existing Thai entry, "เริ่มสมัครเข้าศึกษา...", which a better score would pick. Everything else in the list is plainly wrong, and the grade, password and certificate cases are the worst.

I did not re-run the full 92-question set, so the 50 and 29 counts are not independently confirmed. The 13 listed items confirm the pattern.

Not design intent. The design rules say an unknown question must get an honest not-found with options and a staff hand-off. Here the answer is wrong, and it looks official. The grade case (a private lookup) and the fee-as-5-baht case are the worst because they look authoritative.

Code path, read but not instrumented. _askCore calls search(q), which calls wasm_kb_search (crates/reflex-wasm/src/lib.rs::kb_search) or _jsSearch, then decideTier. I could not read the raw scores because the script is type=module and search is not on window. Inferred cause: decideTier returns 'act' when top.s>=4 and the gate is low, or when top.s>=4 and the margin to second is >=2, or when top.s>=3. In cos_to_score, a cosine of 0.20 already gives s=4 and 0.15 gives s=3. The scoring uses character 3-grams of the keywords field, so Thai function and generic substrings (ค่าธรรมเนียม, การศึกษา, นักศึกษา, เปลี่ยน, รหัส) can reach 0.15-0.20 with no real topic overlap. The last branch of decideTier, top.s>=3 'act', is the loosest, and it covers cosine 0.15-0.20.

confirmed.title: Common phrasings of covered questions return a WRONG entry (fees, deadlines, MU GRAD, TOEFL ITP, APA, committee)
confirmed.repro: Fresh page each: ค่าสมัครเรียนเท่าไหร่ครับ | ค่าสมัคร | สอบผ่านแล้วต้องส่งเล่มกี่วันครับ | ค่าปรับลงทะเบียนล่าช้า | เพิ่มลดรายวิชาวันไหน | สมัครภาคต้น 2570 รอบ 1 เมื่อไหร่ครับ | สอบ mu grad plus สอบที่ไหน | ขอผลสอบ TOEFL ITP ยังไงครับ | ต้องใช้ APA ไหมในวิทยานิพนธ์ | เปลี่ยนชื่อเรื่องวิทยานิพนธ์หลังสอบ ทำไง | Turnitin Originality Report ส่งที่ไหน | คุณสมบัติกรรมการ.
confirmed.expected: admission_fee/gm_application_fee (500 บาท); gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline (21 วัน); the 2,000 baht late-registration fine in the schedule entries; registration schedule with year/term ask; mugrad_seat; toefl_itp_result; thesis_citation; gm_thesis_submission_07_title_change; thesis_turnitin; thesis_committee_qual.
confirmed.actual: Fee questions show TOEFL ITP fee '1,700 บาท'; send-days shows the flat-fee maintain entry; late fee shows the thesis late FINE; add/drop shows flat-fee refund; 'ภาคต้น 2570 รอบ 1' shows the registration schedule; MU GRAD seat shows the fee; TOEFL result shows the fee; APA shows scholarship search; title change shows the topic-change entry; Turnitin shows e-Thesis upload; committee shows an English programme-eligibility card. 31 of 792 variants wrong; gold items #61, #83, #104 wrong. Wrong money/deadline figures appear in bold first.
confirmed.fix:
Smallest correct fix, data only and shared by the Rust and JS engines: add colloquial aliases to the "keywords" field of the target entries in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json, and rebuild or regenerate any copy the wasm uses.
- admission_fee and gm_application_fee: ค่าสมัครเรียน, ค่าสมัครเข้าเรียน, สมัครเรียนเท่าไหร่
- gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline: ส่งเล่มกี่วัน, ส่งเล่มหลังสอบผ่าน, สอบผ่านแล้วส่งเล่ม
- mugrad_seat: สอบที่ไหน, ที่นั่งสอบ, ห้องสอบ
- toefl_itp_result: ผลสอบ, ขอผลสอบ, ใบผลสอบ
- thesis_citation: ใช้ APA, รูปแบบอ้างอิง, APA

Then add the 12 phrasings as recall tests with the expected entry ids, run under tests/ against both engines.

If a code change is also wanted, keep it small and put it in lockstep in _jsSearch / _cosToScore in chatbot.html and in reflex-wasm. Use a family-word guard: when the query contains a rare anchor token such as toefl, turnitin, mu grad, apa or บฑ (a token whose DF in the keywords is <= 3) that the top hit's keywords lack, cap that hit's score at 3. When the top two hits come from different categories and the query has no anchor token, return 'disambiguate' in decideTier instead of 'act'. Without the cap and the disambiguate rule, the aliases fix these 12 phrasings but not the next colloquial ones.

Wrong source shown (quoted from .topic and .ans):
- ค่าสมัครเรียนเท่าไหร่ครับ showed "ค่าสมัครสอบ TOEFL ITP เท่าไร" with "1,700 บาท" in the lead position. Expected 500 baht.
- ค่าสมัคร alone showed the same TOEFL ITP fee card (1,700/1,800 baht).
- สอบผ่านแล้วต้องส่งเล่มกี่วันครับ showed "เหมาจ่าย: สอบผ่านแล้วรอเผยแพร่ ยังต้องรักษาสภาพไหม". Expected the 21-day deadline entry.
- ค่าปรับลงทะเบียนล่าช้า showed "คำนวณค่าปรับส่งเล่มล่าช้าอย่างไร", the thesis late fine instead of the registration late fee.
- เพิ่มลดรายวิชาวันไหน showed "เหมาจ่าย: ลดรายวิชาไม่คืนเงิน...", which is a refund note rather than the add/drop dates.
- สอบ mu grad plus สอบที่ไหน showed "ค่าสมัครสอบ MU GRAD Plus เท่าไร" (a fee list) instead of the seat and venue entry.
- ขอผลสอบ TOEFL ITP ยังไงครับ showed the TOEFL ITP fee card instead of toefl_itp_result.
- ต้องใช้ APA ไหมในวิทยานิพนธ์ showed "ค้นทุนการศึกษาและรางวัลวิทยานิพนธ์อย่างไร" (a scholarship search card) instead of thesis_citation.
- เปลี่ยนชื่อเรื่องวิทยานิพนธ์หลังสอบ ทำไง showed "ขอเปลี่ยนหัวข้อวิทยานิพนธ์ (บฑ.49)", the topic-change entry, instead of gm_thesis_submission_07_title_change.
- Turnitin Originality Report ส่งที่ไหน showed "ต้องอัปโหลดเอกสารอะไรในการส่ง e-Thesis". The query is almost the exact title of thesis_turnitin ("ส่ง Turnitin Originality Report อย่างไร"), which makes this the strongest evidence of a ranking weakness.
- คุณสมบัติกรรมการ showed an English "คุณสมบัติผู้สมัคร ... Plan 1.1 Dissertation only ..." programme-eligibility card, with no .topic. thesis_committee_qual was not shown.
- สมัครภาคต้น 2570 รอบ 1 เมื่อไหร่ครับ showed the registration schedule "กำหนดการลงทะเบียน ภาคต้น ปีการศึกษา 2570" (5-12 July 2570). That is wrong for an admission-round question. The expected "registration schedule with year/term ask" in the report is itself debatable, because the question is about applying, not registering.

All of these were confident single answers with no disambiguation chips. The wrong money and number figures are bolded first by the slot-lead logic, so the wrong 1,700 baht appears prominently.

Mitigations on the verdicts:
- "ค่าสมัคร" alone and "คุณสมบัติกรรมการ" are legitimately ambiguous. The defect there is the lack of a disambiguation prompt, not only the wrong pick.
- The TOEFL ITP fee card is also a reasonable answer to a bare "ค่าสมัคร" in a loose sense, but not to "ค่าสมัครเรียน".
- I did not verify the 31/792 or gold #61/#83/#104 figures.

Root cause (read in code, not instrumented): search() in submissions/ui/chatbot.html (_jsSearch, with wasm_kb_search as the twin) does TF-IDF cosine over character 3-grams of each entry's "keywords" string only. Thai function words and 3-grams such as ส่ง, ที่ไหน, ค่าสมัคร, วิทยานิพนธ์ and สอบ outweigh the rare topic token. _cosToScore then turns a cosine of 0.20 or more into s>=4. decideTier acts on s>=4 with a margin of 2 or more, or s>=3, without any family check. The answer is therefore returned as a confident single answer. The module is a script type="module", so search() is not reachable from the console. I could not dump the rankings.

Reproduced in two independent ways: my own headless Chrome on port 9703, fresh page per question, with ?engine=rust and again with ?engine=js. I waited for programmes.json to load and for a new .msg.b without .typing. All 12 questions gave identical top entries on both engines, so this is not a timing or carry-over artefact. It is deterministic. The two engines agree because the JS twin is in lockstep with the Rust code.

Quoted results (source topic and lead text):
- ค่าสมัครเรียนเท่าไหร่ครับ: topic "ค่าสมัครสอบ TOEFL ITP เท่าไร". Bold lead "1,700 บาท" under the green "ข้อมูลทางการ" badge. The correct admission_fee appears only as a chip.
- ค่าสมัคร: the same TOEFL ITP fee entry (graduate student 1,700, general public 1,800). The chips are gm_application_fee, MU GRAD fee, and MU GRAD payment status.
- สอบผ่านแล้วต้องส่งเล่มกี่วันครับ: "เหมาจ่าย: สอบผ่านแล้วรอเผยแพร่ ยังต้องรักษาสภาพไหม". The correct entry "ส่งรูปเล่มวิทยานิพนธ์ภายในกี่วันหลังสอบผ่าน" is only the second chip.
- ค่าปรับลงทะเบียนล่าช้า: "คำนวณค่าปรับส่งเล่มล่าช้าอย่างไร", a thesis late FINE. It is wrong in kind. The chips are registration schedules 2570 and 2569.
- เพิ่มลดรายวิชาวันไหน: "เหมาจ่าย: ลดรายวิชาไม่คืนเงิน..." (flat-fee refund). It does not answer which day.
- สมัครภาคต้น 2570 รอบ 1 เมื่อไหร่ครับ: the registration schedule for ภาคต้น 2570 (5–12 กรกฎาคม 2570). The admissions-schedule entry is only a chip.
- สอบ mu grad plus สอบที่ไหน: "ค่าสมัครสอบ MU GRAD Plus เท่าไร" (a fee table). mugrad_seat is only the third chip.
- ขอผลสอบ TOEFL ITP ยังไงครับ: the TOEFL ITP FEE entry. toefl_itp_result is only the first chip.
- ต้องใช้ APA ไหมในวิทยานิพนธ์: "ค้นทุนการศึกษาและรางวัลวิทยานิพนธ์อย่างไร" (scholarship search). It is wholly unrelated, and thesis_citation has the word "apa" in its keywords.
- เปลี่ยนชื่อเรื่องวิทยานิพนธ์หลังสอบ ทำไง: "ขอเปลี่ยนหัวข้อวิทยานิพนธ์ (บฑ.49)". This is arguable. It is topically close, but it is not the after-exam entry gm_thesis_submission_07_title_change.
- Turnitin Originality Report ส่งที่ไหน: "ต้องอัปโหลดเอกสารอะไรในการส่ง e-Thesis". This is partly relevant, because the body mentions Turnitin. The exact thesis_turnitin entry is chip #1.
- คุณสมบัติกรรมการ: no topic. It shows an English "คุณสมบัติผู้สมัคร (ตามประกาศ) Plan 1.1 Dissertation only..." programme-eligibility card. The chips are only "แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ" and "มีทุนไหม".

Summary: 9 of 12 are clearly the wrong entry, and 3 are arguable (title change, Turnitin, and the registration schedule when the question contains year and term). The reporter's list otherwise holds up.

Severity: I put it at medium rather than high. It is a retrieval-quality gap on colloquial phrasing, not a violation of the design rules. The answers are real manual text and the source title is shown, and the right entry is usually one chip away. Nothing is invented, and the AI is not involved. It is higher than low because the bold slot-lead puts a wrong figure first, under the green official badge: 1,700 baht for "ค่าสมัครเรียน" instead of 500, and a thesis fine for a registration fine. Treat the fee, ค่าปรับ and ส่งเล่ม cases as high priority and the rest as medium.

Mechanism, from reading the code: search() in chatbot.html (around line 588) uses TF-IDF n-gram cosine plus overlap over each entry's `keywords` string only, via wasm_kb_search or _jsSearch. _cosToScore and decideTier then act on it. There is no cross-family penalty. The wrong entries win because they contain the question's generic words ("ค่าสมัคร", "สอบ", "ผ่านแล้ว", "ค่าปรับ") many times in a long keyword list, while the right entries (for example mugrad_seat or toefl_itp_result) have English-only keywords and no Thai alias. decideTier acts when top.s>=4 and the gap to second is >=2, so it answers confidently without disambiguating.

confirmed.title: Soft Skills questions (including the exact title of gm_softskills_eight_domains) are hijacked by the career finder or not understood
confirmed.repro: Ask exactly 'Soft Skills มีทักษะอะไรบ้างตามประกาศ 2569', also 'soft skills มีทักษะอะไรบ้างครับ', 'softskillsมีทักษะอะไรบ้างครับ', 'มีทักษะอะไรบ้างใน soft skills', 'ซอฟต์สกิลคืออะไร', 'ต้องครบ 8 ทักษะซอฟต์สกิลไหม', 'ทักษะ soft skills เป็นเงื่อนไขจบไหม', 'Certificate of Honor คืออะไร'. Same with &engine=js.
confirmed.expected: The Soft Skills entries (eight domains, voluntary 2569, hours); the title is the one case where answering is guaranteed; Certificate of Honor reaches the entry that defines it.
confirmed.actual: The first four show the career finder 'คำถามแบบนี้ไม่มีคำตอบเดียวสำหรับทุกคน...' with 379 programmes. 'ต้องครบ 8 ทักษะซอฟต์สกิลไหม' -> 'จับใจความไม่ได้'; 'เป็นเงื่อนไขจบไหม' -> greeting; Certificate of Honor -> MUCE equivalence entry. This is the only one of 132 exact titles that fails, so the entry never shows follow-up chips.
confirmed.fix:
Fix A (smallest, covers Q1-Q5): in /Users/ozone/projects/ReflexWork/submissions/ui/chatbot.html, function isCareerQuestion (line 1069), add a negative guard for soft skills. For example, add `const _P_SOFT=/soft\s*skills?|ซอฟต์?ท?\s*สกิล|ซอฟท์\s*สกิล|certificate of honor/i;` and make it `return _P_CAREER.test(s) && !_P_OTHER.test(s) && !_P_SOFT.test(s) && !_P_TOPIC.some(...)`. Alternatively, add the soft-skills pattern to _P_OTHER (line 833). It must also be mirrored in the Rust/wasm twin of the career predicate if one exists. I found no Rust source with 'สกิล' in this repo, so the twin may live elsewhere, but the behaviour was identical in both engines. Keep 'อยากพัฒนาทักษะ soft skill' as a career question by only skipping the career branch when the text also has a manual-style cue, such as 'ประกาศ|ตามประกาศ|เงื่อนไขจบ|ครบ|กี่ชั่วโมง|คืออะไร|certificate'. Otherwise just exclude on the soft skills token alone and accept that this case goes to the KB.

Fix B (recall, covers Q6-Q8): in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json, add the keywords 'ซอฟต์สกิล ซอฟท์สกิล ซอฟต์สกิลส์ ครบ 8 ทักษะ Certificate of Honor' to gm_softskills_eight_domains, gm_softskills_voluntary_2569 and gm_softskills_existing_results. Optionally also add 'เงื่อนไขจบ' to the voluntary entry, which already has it in its title. Do this in whatever source generates the index, if the file is generated.

Tests: add a recall test over all 132 entry titles (each must return its own entry), plus these 8 questions. Run it with engine=rust and engine=js. A cheaper structural fix is to run KB search before the career branch and skip the finder when the top score is high. That is a larger change with regression risk on career questions, so I would do A and B first.
notes:
Reproduced all 8 questions in my own headless Chrome (port 9704). The driver is /tmp/qa/verify/F03-0/drv.mjs and the output is out.txt. It used a fresh page per question, waited for programmes.json, then waited for a new .msg.b without .typing. I ran every question twice, with engine=rust and engine=js, and the results were identical in both. I ran each once per engine. I did not repeat runs to measure variance. Nothing here depends on timing, because the outcome is decided by a regex before any KB lookup.

Actual results, quoted:
1. Q1-Q4 ('Soft Skills มีทักษะอะไรบ้างตามประกาศ 2569', 'soft skills มีทักษะอะไรบ้างครับ', 'softskillsมีทักษะอะไรบ้างครับ', 'มีทักษะอะไรบ้างใน soft skills') and Q5 ('ซอฟต์สกิลคืออะไร') all return the career finder: 'คำถามแบบนี้ไม่มีคำตอบเดียวสำหรับทุกคนครับ และผมไม่ได้ทำนายงานหรือรายได้ ... พบ 379 หลักสูตร (กำลังเปิดรับ 207)'. There is no .topic and no follow-up chips. So the F03 claim about the first four holds, and Q5 is hijacked as well.
2. Q6 'ต้องครบ 8 ทักษะซอฟต์สกิลไหม' returns 'ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้'.
3. Q7 'ทักษะ soft skills เป็นเงื่อนไขจบไหม' returns the greeting 'สวัสดีครับ 🦀 ผมเป็นผู้ช่วยตอบคำถาม...'.
4. Q8 'Certificate of Honor คืออะไร' returns the entry gm_softskills_muce_equivalence (topic 'เรียน MUCE ออนไลน์แล้วขอเทียบเคียง Soft Skills...') with 3 follow-ups. That is the wrong entry. The right ones are gm_softskills_existing_results or eight_domains.

Two different root causes, not one.

Cause A: career hijack (Q1-Q5). In chatbot.html line 1067, _P_CAREER contains `(?:skill|ทักษะ|สกิล).{0,6}(?:อะไร|ไหนดี)`. It matches 'skills มีทักษะอะไร' (the 'ทักษะอะไร' part) and 'สกิลคืออะไร'. I ran the regex in node: it is true for Q1 and Q5, false for Q6 and Q7. isCareerQuestion at line 1069 is only a negative check against _P_OTHER (line 833) and _P_TOPIC (line 836), and neither mentions soft skills. The branch at line 1458 `if(!pinned && PROG.length && isCareerQuestion(q))` runs before KB search, so the KB never gets a turn. The same regex also matches 'อยากพัฒนาทักษะ soft skill'. That is a genuine career-style question, so the fix must not remove that case.

Cause B: KB recall (Q6, Q7, Q8). These are not career-routed. The keywords of the Soft Skills entries only contain the Latin 'soft skills' and the title wording. They have no 'ซอฟต์สกิล', 'ซอฟท์สกิล', 'Certificate of Honor' or 'ครบ 8 ทักษะ' wording. As a result, the KB search finds no confident hit for Q6, and Q7 falls through to the greeting. Q8 matches 'certificate' in the MUCE entry's keywords.

Severity: I rate it medium, not high. The failures are real, and the fact that the exact entry title does not return its own entry is embarrassing. But no wrong fact is given. The failures are a misleading generic finder, a not-understood reply, and a greeting, and Q8 reaches a related Soft Skills entry. The design rules (honest not-found, never made up) are not violated. It is a recall and routing defect on a popular topic. Q7 is the one a student is most likely to ask, and it returns a greeting with no hand-off, which is the worst case. I would keep high only if the pitch demo uses these exact questions. The claim that this is the only one of 132 exact titles that fails, I did not check. I only checked the soft-skills title.

This is not intended design. The career branch is supposed to apply to jobs and areas of interest, not to a manual topic whose title is asked verbatim.

Reproduced independently (fresh headless Chrome, port 9705, fresh page per question, waited for programmes.json to load and for the final .msg.b without .typing). Harness: /tmp/qa/verify/F03-1/run.mjs. Results are identical with engine=rust and engine=js, so this is deterministic, not timing. All six of the reported failures reproduced, plus the Certificate of Honor question. 1) The four 'ทักษะอะไรบ้าง' / 'ซอฟต์สกิลคืออะไร' questions, including the exact title 'Soft Skills มีทักษะอะไรบ้างตามประกาศ 2569', return the career finder: '✅ ข้อมูลทางการ คำถามแบบนี้ไม่มีคำตอบเดียวสำหรับทุกคนครับ และผมไม่ได้ทำนายงานหรือรายได้ แต่ช่วยแคบรายการหลักสูตร... พบ 379 หลักสูตร (กำลังเปิดรับ 207)'. There is no .topic and no follow-up chips. The title is in the knowledge index as gm_softskills_eight_domains, so it should answer. 2) 'ต้องครบ 8 ทักษะซอฟต์สกิลไหม' returns 'ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้'. 3) 'ทักษะ soft skills เป็นเงื่อนไขจบไหม' returns the greeting 'สวัสดีครับ ... มีเรื่องอะไรให้ช่วยไหมครับ'. 4) 'Certificate of Honor คืออะไร' returns the MUCE equivalence entry ('เรียน MUCE ออนไลน์แล้วขอเทียบเคียง Soft Skills ได้อย่างไร'). That entry does contain the phrase, and it is arguably acceptable because it is the only entry that does. Real-world impact is lower than the finding suggests. Working controls: 'Soft Skills มีกี่ชั่วโมง' reaches the hours entry with 3 chips, and 'soft skill ต้องทำไหม' gives a 'คุณอาจหมายถึง' list that includes the title entry. So the Soft Skills topic is reachable, but the most natural question forms are not. Root cause confirmed in the code. In submissions/ui/chatbot.html, _P_CAREER (line ~1065) contains the clause (?:skill|ทักษะ|สกิล).{0,6}(?:อะไร|ไหนดี). 'ทักษะอะไร' and 'สกิลคืออะไร' match it. isCareerQuestion (line 1069) only vetoes via _P_OTHER (line 833) and _P_TOPIC, and neither knows Soft Skills. The career branch (line ~1458) runs before KB search, so the KB is never consulted. I checked the regex directly: the title and 'ซอฟต์สกิลคืออะไร' match, and 'ต้องครบ 8 ทักษะซอฟต์สกิลไหม' does not. That last question is a separate KB recall miss. I found no Rust source containing the career regex, so the logic appears to be in the JS file that both engines share. The Rust engine gave identical output. I did not verify the Rust side beyond that. Severity: I downgrade from high to medium. It is a real, deterministic defect, and the exact-title failure is embarrassing, but the answer is wrong-but-safe (an honest finder, no fabricated facts), one topic is affected, and a user can still reach the content with other wording. The suggested 'run KB search first and skip the career branch' is a larger change than needed and risks regressions.

confirmed.fix: Smallest data-only fix: add colloquial synonyms to the `keywords` of the affected entries in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json (or in its generator). Both engines read this field, so Rust and JS stay in step. Examples are ตรวจเล่ม, พักการเรียน, โดนล็อก, เครียด, เส้นตาย, ใช้ AI/ChatGPT, โอนต่างธนาคาร, เบอร์โทร/ไลน์, จอง GRID, MUGRAD Plus. For the script-boundary slips (จองGRID, MUGRADPlus), normalise the query before the 3-gram step by inserting a space at each Thai/Latin transition. Do this in _jsGramSet/search() in submissions/ui/chatbot.html and in the matching function in crates/reflex-wasm/src/lib.rs, in lockstep, with a golden test. Optional second stage: in showNotFound(), when ranked[0].s is 1, still offer the top 3 as options (loosen `r.s>=2`). confirmed.area: programme resolver / KB fallback (_askCore, resolveProgramme feeTopic, _P_TOPIC)
confirmed.repro: Fresh page: ค่าเทอมปริญญาเอก | ค่าเรียนปริญญาเอกกี่บาท | ทุนปริญญาโท | เปิดรับสมัครไหม ปริญญาเอก | ค่าเทอมพยาบาล | ค่าเทอมทั่วไป | ค่าเทอมทั่วไปเท่าไหร่ | ค่าเทอมเท่าไร | ค่าเรียนเท่าไร | ค่าเทอมเท่าไร repeated 500 times. Compare ค่าเทอมโท and ค่าเทอมเท่าไหร่ which work.
confirmed.expected: The general fee entry or the fee finder (as 'ค่าเทอมโท', 'ค่าเทอมนานาชาติ', 'ค่าเทอมเท่าไหร่' do); the code comment says ค่าเทอมพยาบาล should get the KB general fee answer.
confirmed.actual: Level+fee/scholarship questions return the how-to-apply entry; ค่าเทอมพยาบาล returns the health-services reimbursement entry; ค่าเทอมทั่วไป returns the card of 3309M03G dental programme with 70,000 baht ('ทั่วไป' matched as a name); ปริญญาโท/ปริญญาเอก alone give how-to-apply. confirmed.fix:
Smallest fix is in _askCore() in submissions/ui/chatbot.html. Place it next to the fee-premise block (~line 1484), before `search(q)` and decideTier, and mirror it in the Rust/wasm twin so both engines agree.

Add a 'generic fee/scholarship question' guard. Condition: not pinned, PROG.length, resolveProgramme returned null or kind 'broad', and _P_TOPIC fee or scholarship matches. Strip the topic words, then strip these fillers: level words (ปริญญาโท/เอก/โท/เอก), ทั่วไป/ปกติ/โดยทั่วไป, เท่าไหร่/เท่าไร/กี่บาท, ไหม, มี, สมัคร. If nothing meaningful is left, call `renderFinder(q, d, kstrip, <fee text>, true, null, true, 'ค่าเทอม ')`, preselecting the level where one was given.

Supporting changes in resolveProgramme:
- Add ทั่วไป|ปกติ|โดยทั่วไป|เท่าไ?หร่|กี่บาท|ปริญญา(?:โท|เอก)|โท|เอก to _P_FUNC, or strip them from `text` before building needles. That stops 'ทั่วไป' matching a programme name and 70,000 appearing as a card.
- Change the `pool.length>12 && feeTopic` case from `null` to a signal such as {kind:'fee-generic'}, so ค่าเทอมพยาบาล goes to the finder (or at least the general fee entry) instead of falling into free KB search.
- Normalise ค่าเรียน and ค่าเล่าเรียน to ค่าเทอม, and เท่าไร to เท่าไหร่, before the existing finder trigger.

The 500x-repeat case is a separate, low-priority issue: cap or de-duplicate repeated tokens before search.

Actual answers, quoted:
- ค่าเทอมปริญญาเอก, ค่าเรียนปริญญาเอกกี่บาท and ทุนปริญญาโท all return the how-to-apply entry. Topic line: 'ที่มา: เริ่มสมัครเข้าศึกษาระดับบัณฑิตศึกษาอย่างไร'. Body starts 'เลือกหลักสูตรจากหน้าหลักสูตรที่เปิดรับสมัคร ตรวจคุณสมบัติ...'.
- เปิดรับสมัครไหม ปริญญาเอก returns the same entry.
- ค่าเทอมพยาบาล returns the health-services reimbursement entry: 'หน้าสวัสดิการมีลิงก์หลักเกณฑ์บริการสุขภาพ... ใบคำร้องขอเบิกค่ารักษาพยาบาล'. The code comment at chatbot.html:911 says it should get the KB general fee answer.
- ค่าเทอมทั่วไป and ค่าเทอมทั่วไปเท่าไหร่ both return a programme fee card: '💰 ค่าธรรมเนียม (ตามประกาศ ปีการศึกษา 2570) ... เหมาจ่าย 70,000 บาท/ภาคการศึกษา' with chips 'แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ / มีทุนไหม'. This is one arbitrary programme's fee shown as if it were the answer, so it is the worst case.
- ค่าเทอมเท่าไร returns 'คุณอาจหมายถึง ... ค่าสมัครสอบ TOEFL ITP เท่าไร / ค่าสมัครเข้าศึกษาเท่าไร... / เลือกประกาศค่าเล่าเรียนให้ตรงปีและหลักสูตร'.
- ค่าเรียนเท่าไร returns the same kind of 'คุณอาจหมายถึง' list, again led by TOEFL ITP.
- ค่าเทอมเท่าไร repeated 500 times returns '1,700 บาท ค่าสมัครสอบ TOEFL ITP...' as a confident answer. This one is artificial and low priority.
- The controls behave as reported. ค่าเทอมโท gives the general fee-announcement entry. ค่าเทอมเท่าไหร่ opens the fee finder with 379 programmes and level chips. ค่าเทอมนานาชาติ opens the finder narrowed to 202.

This is not a test artefact or design intent. The design rules say an unknown question gets an honest not-found or finder, and facts must be correct. A random programme's fee, or an exam-fee list for 'tuition', breaks that. The finder trigger depends on the ไหร่ and ไร spelling.

Root cause, from reading the code:
1. resolveProgramme (chatbot.html ~868-915) strips _P_TOPIC and _P_ASK words, leaving needles such as 'ปริญญาเอก', 'ทั่วไป', 'เท่าไร' or 'พยาบาล'. _P_FUNC (line 864) does not cover those words.
   - 'ทั่วไป' trigram-matches a programme name, giving the 70,000 dental card.
   - 'พยาบาล' gives a pool above 12, so feeTopic returns null (line 911).
2. When the resolver returns null, the code goes to KB search. The fee finder is only reached in a late low-confidence branch (~line 1678, `PROG.length && _P_TOPIC[0][1].test(q)`).
   - For a level+fee question, KB search returns a confident how-to-apply entry, so the finder is never reached.
   - For ค่าเทอมเท่าไร, decideTier returns a 'คุณอาจหมายถึง' clarify list that also pre-empts the finder.
3. The fee-premise early path (line 1484) only fires for _P_FREEQ questions, so there is no early generic-fee route.

These answers are off-topic or wrong, and the ทั่วไป case states another programme's fee as if it were the answer. confirmed.title: Follow-up context (PCTX) sticks to the old programme when the question names its own field, and survives pickers/broad lists
confirmed.repro: Single page. A: 'สมัคร 2022M04G' then 'ค่าเทอมสาธารณสุข' (or 'ทุนวิศวกรรม', 'แล้วทุนการพยาบาลล่ะ', 'สอบสัมภาษณ์วันไหน ทันตแพทย์'; or 'สมัคร 2019D05G' then 'ค่าเทอมพยาบาล'). B: 'สมัคร 2022M04G', then 'mph' (picker of 7) or 'สมัคร พยาบาล' (30) or 'สมัคร ทันตแพทย์', then 'แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ' / 'มีทุนไหม'.
confirmed.expected: A follow-up naming its own scope must not reuse the previous programme; after a picker for another subject a bare follow-up should not silently reuse the earlier card.
confirmed.actual: A: 'ตีความว่าถามเรื่องค่าธรรมเนียมของ ...จิตวิทยาคลินิก' for a public health/nursing/dental question. B: 'follow-up: fee -> 2022M04G' although the last thing shown was a picker. Labelled with an undo chip but still a wrong-programme answer. Resolver returns null so followUpAspect accepts the short question; 'many'/'broad' branches never reset PCTX.
confirmed.fix:
File submissions/ui/chatbot.html (check whether a Rust/wasm twin of this logic exists; I only saw it in the HTML).
1) followUpAspect(q) (line ~925): after finding the aspect hit, build a residue = raw with ALL _P_ASPECT regex matches removed (use global copies of each regex) and filler words removed (แล้ว, ล่ะ, ละ, ไหม, หรือเปล่า, เท่าไหร่, เท่าไร, อะไร, บ้าง, ด้วย, นะ, ครับ, ค่ะ, คะ, ของ, หลักสูตรนี้, อันนี้, ที่นี่, เดือน, ปี, punctuation/space). If the residue still contains >=3 Thai/Latin characters, return '' (the question names its own scope, e.g. สาธารณสุข, วิศวกรรม, พยาบาล, ทันตแพทย์). This sends it to the normal KB/scope/finder path which already gives an honest 'which programme?' answer. Caveat: Thai has no spaces so stripping must be regex-based, not token-based; keep a short allow-list for generic words like 'ที่นี่', 'หลักสูตรนี้'. Cheaper alternative: refuse if the question contains any word from the set of faculty/subject words derived from PROG titles/faculty (the same lexicon resolveProgramme uses) that is not in the current PCTX row's title.
2) In _askCore, in the prog branch (line ~1425-1451) set PCTX=null in the else (kind 'many'/'broad') branch before add(...), and likewise in renderFinder entry paths (the fee-premise and other renderFinder calls already follow the PCTX=null at line 1481, but line 1464/1459 do it; confirm every renderFinder caller resets). Picker chips re-ask 'สมัคร CODE', which re-sets PCTX via kind==='one', so this does not break the pick-then-follow-up flow.
3) Keep the 'ไม่ใช่ — ถามแบบทั่วไป' undo chip. Add regression cases to the existing e2e (A and B sequences above).
notes: Fully reproduced. Mitigations that exist: the answer says which programme it interpreted ('ตีความว่าถามเรื่อง... ของ <title>') and shows an undo chip, so it is labelled, not silent. Still a wrong-programme answer: for A the user explicitly named a different field and got real fee/scholarship/interview data for the previous programme (2019D05G immunology fee table shown for a nursing question), which is the kind of confident wrong fact the design rules forbid ('never a made-up answer'). Not design intent: the PCTX comment says a follow-up may refer to the last single-programme card, but a question carrying its own subject words is not a follow-up. Scenario B is less severe than A: after a picker the user plausibly might still mean the earlier card, but the picker is a clear context switch and the code comment at line 1481 ('never pin a later question to an old programme') shows the intent is to drop PCTX; the many/broad branches return before reaching that line, which is the gap. I confirmed by code reading: line 1433 sets PCTX only for kind 'one'; the else branch returns without clearing; line 1467 uses PCTX whenever followUpAspect(q) is non-empty and resolveProgramme returned null. Severity: I keep high for A (wrong data, specific numbers possible), medium for B. Repro script is at /tmp/qa/verify/F06-0/run.mjs.

Reproduced 9 of 9 sequences, one fresh page per sequence, port 9711, default Rust engine, script at /tmp/qa/verify/F06-1/run.mjs. I did not run ?engine=js. I used the same fixed-wait harness as the repo's coverage_probe.mjs, so a timing artefact is unlikely.

Part A (question names its own field):
- 'สมัคร 2022M04G' then 'ค่าเทอมสาธารณสุข' returned: "ตีความว่าถามเรื่องค่าธรรมเนียมของ วิทยาศาสตรมหาบัณฑิต สาขาวิชาจิตวิทยาคลินิก ไม่ใช่ — ถามแบบทั่วไป 💰 ค่าธรรมเนียม: ประกาศปีการศึกษา 2570 ของหลักสูตรนี้ยังไม่ระบุอัตรา...".
- 'ทุนวิศวกรรม' and 'แล้วทุนการพยาบาลล่ะ' each returned the clinical psychology scholarship card.
- 'สอบสัมภาษณ์วันไหน ทันตแพทย์' returned the clinical psychology schedule.
- 'สมัคร 2019D05G' then 'ค่าเทอมพยาบาล' returned the Immunology PhD fee table.

Part B (picker or broad list in between):
- 'สมัคร 2022M04G', then 'mph' (picker of 7), then 'แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ' returned the clinical psychology fee card.
- The same happened after 'สมัคร พยาบาล' (30 results, 'broad') followed by 'มีทุนไหม', and after 'สมัคร ทันตแพทย์' (2 results) followed by 'แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ'.

Control: 'สมัคร 2022M04G' then 'แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ' correctly reuses the card. That is the intended behaviour, and it carries the "ตีความว่า..." text and the undo chip.

Cause, confirmed in chatbot.html:
- followUpAspect (about line 925) only rejects a question if _P_OTHER, a level, a programme code or a Mahidol/general word matches. A subject word such as สาธารณสุข or พยาบาล is not checked.
- resolveProgramme returns null for 'ค่าเทอมสาธารณสุข', so the follow-up branch (about line 1467) accepts the question with PCTX still set.
- In _askCore, the programme-resolver block (about lines 1431-1455) sets PCTX only for kind==='one'. The 'many' and 'broad' branches return without clearing it. The unconditional `PCTX=null` at about line 1481 is never reached.

Design check: the answer is labelled and has an undo chip, and it comes from the catalogue, not from the AI. So it breaks no rule about invented facts. But the card is for a different programme than the one the student named, so it is a wrong-programme answer, not intended design. I rate it medium, not high. The wrong card is labelled, but when a fee is missing it reads as "this programme has no fee".

Proposed fix:
1. In _askCore, add `PCTX=null;` inside the `else` (many/broad) branch of `if(prog){...}`. This fixes Part B. In renderFinder this is already done for the career and finder paths.
2. In followUpAspect, after the aspect matches, strip the matched aspect regexes and function words (แล้ว, ล่ะ, ไหม, ครับ, ค่ะ, หน่อย, บ้าง, คือ, เท่าไหร่, เท่าไร, และ, ของ, ที่). Keep the strip list small and test it against the existing follow-up questions. Return '' if 3 or more Thai or Latin characters remain. This fixes Part A.
3. If there is a Rust twin of followUpAspect, change it too. It was not checked.

Caveat: 'สอบสัมภาษณ์วันไหน' has วัน, ไหน and สอบ matches, so the stripping must remove every matched aspect word. A regex-replace over all _P_ASPECT patterns is enough.
